svg.text: OmegaT — open feature requests, clustered by theme

630 open tickets, data as of 2026-08-18. Box colour = ticket age in one-year steps. Hover for the full title and summary. Clicking an overview or table entry scrolls to the full-size box further down without touching the browser history.
Each cluster has an accent colour; extra outer frames on an overview box mean the ticket also matches those clusters. Cluster headers sum the badges of their tickets.
Overview — click a box to zoom to its full entry

g.title: #1784 (2025-08-18) INIFilter to support multi-line value [File filters & formats] INIFilter currently does not parse values with continuation lines as a single, multiline value.

#1766 (2024-11-08) Customize segment properties fields [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Problem to be solved The current top-to-bottom order of fields in the Segment Properties pane is not optimal, as some very important fields appear at the bottom, which can be easily hidden by another pane when the contents expand too much the height of the pane is variable depending on the content . In my case, I would really need my users to see the "Is alternative" field right at the top, but in

#1759 (2024-08-18) filter: improve error message when wrong char encoding is configured in bundle properties filter [File filters & formats] [Spelling, tags & QA] The error message does not specify which file filter has a problem, because the exceptoin is raised in AbstractFilter class and the error message, FILTERMASTER ERROR UNKNOWN ENCODING, is recorded in FilterMaster class. That makes it impossible for the user to fix the issue without requesting support only with the error message. It may be happened by a reason why there is a stack trace message that

#1742 (2024-04-17) Support for .mqxlz files created in MemoQ [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] An mqxlz file is basically a zip file. It contains two files: document.mqxliff and skeleton.xml. Currently, the mqxliff can be extracted from the mqxlz and translated in OmegaT. skeleton.xml is used by MemoQ to allow export of the xliff back into the original document of the file. There would be hence no reason to edit skeleton.xml in OmegaT. I believe this should be fairly simple to implement: Om

#1741 (2024-03-18) Request for xhtml file format from unpacked epub support [File filters & formats] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Statistics & counting] Hi, I originally reported this on the subreddit and the mailing list, and was asked to send a request here. I have attached a sample of the specific type of xhtml, which breaks after translation through OmegaT. OmegaT deletes part of the tags causing the file to report xml parsing errors.

#1740 (2024-03-05) automatically set modify encoding declaration to "never" for certain file formats [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] In order to avoid errors when creating translated documents, set the modify encoding declaration option in the global file filters to "never" for formats like html and xhtml that are used for unzipped ebooks.
#1739 (2024-03-04) request for enhancement [File filters & formats] An option for the HTML filter that allows users to remove ruby data.

#1723 (2023-08-01) Provide a way to minimum escape of quotation marks in XML filters incl. resx-writer [File filters & formats] [Installation & platform] Since the V6.0.0 Update, the resx-writer escapes all quotation marks as " This is not strictly false but unnessesary and hard to read and different from the source-text. Version 6.0.0 To reproduce, translate the attached resx-file. source: ...<value "Hochtüddel"</value ... expected target: ...<value "Quotation mark"</value ... instead: ...<value "Quotation mark"</value ...

#1694 (2023-04-25) Handle Input Method mode/status/event properly [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] OmegaT does not handle any "Input-Method" events, almost nothing. Translators who use OmegaT on Chinese-Japanese-Korean-Vietnum ennvironment and who use CJK as target langauge may got some inconvenient behavior on it. Application should handle Input Method events through Java Input Method Framework, introduced in Java 1.3.1, 20 yrs ago. see This requires big changes in codes, and deep knowlege of

#1689 (2023-03-17) Improve the error messages [File filters & formats] The error messages should have informative value and help the user take action about what is wrong. See the mail on the dev list:

#1662 (2023-01-06) Investigate modern html parsers [File filters & formats] It might be possible to upgrade htmlparser to 1.6 depending on its license. It could be interesting to explore other parsers. Jsoup seems pretty common and its license is compatible.

#1654 (2022-11-23) Disable filters that should not handle a file [File filters & formats] When a file is handled by a file filter up in the list, it seems to be also read by file filters down the list and that can create conflict. For ex. OmegaT's filter for MS files ignores temporary files but when reloading a project that has temporary files properly ignored by OmegaT's filter , the Okapi filter that is not equipped to ignore such files raises an error and keep the project from reloa

#1638 (2022-10-09) Web Scraper: generic web scraping and import as source feature [File filters & formats] OmegaT has a feature to import Wikipedia/MediaWiki page as source. It is useful if OmegaT can handle several type of web site, not only for wikipedia. This is a feature proposal that web scraping feature that download web contents and filter it for importing. WIkipedia/Mediawiki should be one of option of scraper. Here is a list of candidate of target web site/web systems - MediaWiki/WIkipedia - O

#1621 (2022-06-27) Add notes as <note> in target XLIFF file [File filters & formats] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Background One of the more problematic aspects of working in OmegaT in some projects that require some feedback from linguists not just the translation is the fact that this feedback cannot be transferred directly from OmegaT to the system that will receive the translated files. The linguist must insert their comments separately in another file or in another interface. This can be very time-consum

#1618 (2022-05-15) Additional $FileShortPathOnly template variable for the post-processing command [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] Creation of an additional template variable for the post-processing command: $FileShortPathOnly or whatever variable name is suitable What is needed is a variable for the subfolder in which the source or target file is located. For example, here are the existing file-related template variables for a hypothetical target file /home/user/projects/myProject/target/subFolder/myFile.docx ${filePath} /ho

#1616 (2022-05-12) Non-unique IDs when segmenting text blocks extracted by Okapi OpenXML filter [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Current behaviour The Okapi OpenXML filter extracts text blocks paragraphs and assigns them an ID, e.g. NFDBB2FA9-tu1 which OmegaT displays as NFDBB2FA9-tu1 0 . If segmentation is disabled in OmegaT, the segment contains the whole text block and NFDBB2FA9-tu1 0 is the ID the segment will have. For whatever reason OmegaT appends 0 to the ID that the Okapi OpenXML generates. If segmentation is enabl

#1590 (2021-09-14) Ignore images embedded in html [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] From this thread: OmegaT should automatically exclude data:image content in the SCR attribute in HTML.

#1577 (2021-06-21) Filter plug-in for AsciiDoc [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Documentation & localisation] I would like a filter plug-in for AsciiDoc. Markdown filters could be found in the Okapi Filters Plugin for OmegaT. However, AsciiDoc was not handled. AsciiDoc may be more niche than Markdown, but it is used in the documentation of a well-known open source CMS is Drupal. Drupal User Guide Thank you.

#1576 (2021-06-18) Features for subtitling [File filters & formats] [Statistics & counting] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Hi, I would like to suggest developments to work on subtitle translation with srt files. A few features/plugin would be very helpful, listed here: - word count per line with color code alert if exceeding and filter to review the segment that do not comply - enable a CPM/CPS character per minute/second and WPM word per minute count - have the possibility to read the video within OmegaT and to synch

#1561 (2021-03-28) Export improvements to cut post-processing effort [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Documentation & localisation] Hi, First and foremost thanks a lot for your dedicated work on OmegaT! It would be awesome to see some improvements that would cut post-processing times after translating doc files. Such as: - exporting segment notes put in OmegaT into comments within the doc output. omitting manual copy-and past of notes into the target document - either correctly attribute rich text formatting or drop it altoget

#1555 (2021-03-09) TOML file filter [File filters & formats] [Documentation & localisation] There is a case that use TOML file as a message catalog. Here is an example; It is great if INI filter support TOML Here is a specification: Current INI filter support quoted value and section. So it will work with very simple toml file. But it does not support multiple line value with triple quotes, quote inside triple quotes, inline comment, and so on.

#1549 (2021-01-23) Preference->Plugin dialog show plugin information in 3-panes [File filters & formats] [Machine translation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] Current 5.3.0- plugin dialog shows just a table of installed plugin. User can see very short description in UI. It seems better to show 3-pain UI, left side: table with name and category filter, mt, etc.. , right side: author, version, long description, project link, and at bottom: buttons activate, deactivate, uninstall, install, config, etc., It may be a similar UI with NetBeans IDE's plugin dia

#1523 (2020-10-12) Filter by segment number [File filters & formats] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, OmegaT can filter segments so that only those segments are visible , and then various shortcuts can be used on the filtered segments specifically e.g. Next, Previous, Find/Replace . However, segments can currently only be filtered based on the content of the segment or the author or date of the segment . A user can't filter a specific group of segments unless they have unique definable

#1502 (2020-07-29) Let pressing Filter button cancel previous filter automatically [File filters & formats] [Search & replace] [Scripting, plugins & automation] Currently, if a filter is active, pressing the Filter button on the Find dialog does nothing, because the previously applied filter first has to be removed. I suggest making it so that when a user pressed the Filter button on the Find dialog while a previous filter is active, the previous filter is cancelled and the current filter gets applied.
#1492 (2020-05-13) Dedicated .strings filter [File filters & formats] Following the discussion at bugs: 993 I'm filling a RFE to have a proper .strings filter.

#1409 (2018-11-15) Have identical wording on download page and About box [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] Problem: when OmegaT reminds me to download the latest version, I click the button which takes me to the web page, but once I arrive there I don't know which version to download because I can't remember which version I downloaded previously. The About box in OmegaT itself only shows the version number, and not the type e.g. with java, without java, etc . Suggestion: let the type of download from w

#1404 (2018-09-21) Integrate IBM Speech to Text service to OmegaT [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Documentation & localisation] Integrate IBM Speech to Text service to OmegaT. The objective is to enable the user to dictate the translation into the target field and notes. Regards, FMC

#1398 (2018-08-07) Take the HTML 5 attribute "translate" into account [File filters & formats] [Spelling, tags & QA] Hi When I set the HTML 5 attribute "translate" to "no", OmegaT v4.1.5 1 does not protect against translation the "span" that has this attribute. Example:

#1396 (2018-07-13) Apple Numbers file filter [File filters & formats] It could be useful and perhaps not difficult to develop a file filter for Apple Numbers spreadsheet file format using extension numbers . It's the embedded iwa files that actually need dealing with…

#1327 (2017-07-24) Update the Project Files basic stats when filtering is ON [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] When filtering in ON in the Project Files dialog, only the displayed file names are modified but the totals remain the same. It would be nice to have them updated to correspond to the filtered display.

#1272 (2016-09-27) Feature to clean HTML comments using conditions [File filters & formats] Currently we are using OmegaT to translate our web application. The translated HTML has been cleaned by removing HTML comments. config: filters.xml: '<option name="removeComments" value="true"/ ' But it removes also conditional comments introduced by Microsoft, years ago. Which breaks our lay-out. Ofcourse there are other solutions to restore the missing code in HTML comments. But it would be nice

#1257 (2016-06-27) Support Ddoc document [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] Hi everyone, Thank you very much to help me for 'support Ddoc document'. Ddoc is a doc format of D language,it's very useful for D. It's Extension name is .d, For example, here is a Ddoc that name is 'object.d'. Please See Ddoc documents and OmegaT pictures, ------- object.d ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ---------------------------------------------
#1206 (2016-03-28) Option to ignore hidden sheets in Excel [File filters & formats] Sometimes Excel contains hidden sheets which do not have to be translated.

#1205 (2016-03-27) Real time HTML Translation Preview [File filters & formats] [Alignment] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] Hi folks! Now that we already one of the long awaited killer features, the Aligner, I think it's time for a real time translation preview. It could work as follows: - The document is converted into an HTML file that shows the original file layout. - Simple rules: show original segment in the html when there's no a translation and show translation when it exits. - Autosave has a lot to do here so t

#1157 (2015-11-18) Add XLIFF/HTML-table export/import capability [File filters & formats] [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Statistics & counting] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] I know Kos has some great scripts for exporting a xliff file that one translated somewere else can be imported as a TMX to OmegaT preserving OmegaT tags but I find some problems: 1. It fills not translated segments with the source, so no really usefull as we should review the whole file to decide what to translate, loosing statistics and so on. 2. I still haven't been able to import back the file

#1127 (2015-09-14) Markdown and ReStructuredText(ReST) filter [File filters & formats] It will be useful when supporting Markdown and ReST as source text format. There are many OSS document written by these format.

#1120 (2015-08-31) Direct Filtering in Current File [File filters & formats] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be useful to be able to filter segments of the current file using text selected in the Editor window without having to open Text Search window and to click on 'Filter' button.

#1095 (2015-06-09) LaTeX filter: respect layout of non-translatable text [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] Requested by Marco Cevoli: Currently, the LaTeX filter completely rewrites the output. If the translated document is to be maintained once translated, that makes it difficult to use. Non-translatable text should be output "as is", without any change in formatting. The following example, except the translatable part, should stay the same after translation. relax chapter{TRANSLATABLE TEXT} label{lab

#1084 (2015-04-13) Show context information of XML files in Comments pane [File filters & formats] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] A user asks on ProZ.com whether it can be possible for OmegaT to show some context information while tranlsating XML file. My suggestion is that in XML filters there be an option to allow OmegaT to show some of the surrounding text in the XML file as context, in the Comments pane. I think the user should be able to select how many tag "nests" he wants to have displayed. In other words, for the fol

#1081 (2015-04-04) Organize file filters by categories [File filters & formats] [Search & replace] [Documentation & localisation] To help the user find and manage file filters, and considering their growing numbers 34 at the time of writing we could have categories localization formats, web, office suite, etc. to group them. This RFE is derived from: 567

#1074 (2015-03-22) Limit target string length by using separate length data [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] [Documentation & localisation] In localization files, the target data can sometimes be limited to a set number of characters. This RFE would allow the user to specify a column in a tabular data file to specify the length of segments of the corresponding segments. For ex, when translating an Excel file with a string length column, the user could specify that column, which would make OmegaT ignore it for display purposes but inst

#1063 (2015-02-09) Option to remove Phonetic Guide text from ods files [File filters & formats] OpenDocument Spreadsheet ods files converted from xls/xlsx files occasionally include Phonetic Guide also called Ruby or Furigana text, which is most likely unnecessary for translation. It would be helpful to have a file filter option to remove the Phonetic Guide text.

#1050 (2014-12-08) Subrip (srt) configurable option to merge all lines into one line. [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Somewhat related to feature-request 606. We use Camtasia Studio and it generates SRT files like this: <preamble with number and time LINE 1 LINE 2 LINE 3 <separating empty line What Camtasia does, it automatically reformats the lines 1, 2 and 3 such that the content fits. So in fact, it does not matter how you break the individual lines in the translation, Camtasia will do it better in general and

#1025 (2014-09-02) Display warning when adding translating files with unsupported file format [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] I oftenly add a whole folder sometimes even with subfolders of source files to a project instead of choosing single files. I happened more than one time, that I accidentally had files in my folders e.g. .doc instead of .docx that are not supported by OmegaT. I simply forgot to convert them before. Only after I finished the project I wondered that not all files have been translated. I would be nice

#978 (2014-03-26) Sysfilter AI export XML filter [File filters & formats] As a follow up to 928 and similar to the Infix filter, create a filter for Sysfilter AI export XML format. The structure is: I have a sample, feel free to contact me if you want to handle this RFE.

#967 (2014-03-07) Support for Invantive Composition templates [File filters & formats] [Spelling, tags & QA] This is a specific format which builds upon Microsoft Word. It is a piece of add-in software that allows Word documents to contain placeholders for data fetched from a database, webservice or application. Typically used to create first draft versions of legal pleading, sales and purchase contracts and AO/IC. The tags are of the type: <invantive:value-of .../>, <invantive:foreach ...>,

#951 (2014-02-01) Graceful compile as much as you can not stopping at first crash [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Project handling & files] Current behavior: We have a large project with many files. On some files OmegaT sometimes chokes and crashes with an error. All files following the source file that caused the crash are not translated, although they are finished. We use console mode. Desired behavior: When OmegaT has a filter that crashes during compilation on a file, it remembers this and continues with the other files. When one

#920 (2013-11-19) Add filter for .csv files [File filters & formats] User should select: 1 Role of each column in file text column, key column for example, msgid in monolingal .po or ignore column 2 Column divider , ; tab or user defined divider 3 Text divider "text" 'text' or text without brackets You can see good .csv implementation in LibreOffice.

#907 (2013-10-26) Project properties window is resizeable but the width never shrinked [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] Project properties window width can be wider, but can not be narrowed. It is an one-way action. So if you change it too much wider, you must close it, re-open it and try again. See this. ! demo animation

#885 (2013-08-10) HTML: allow to translate the content of <object> [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] <b Description Steps to reproduce :</b Testcase: <code <p><object data="content.svg" height="288" width="1000"><img alt="" height="288" src="content.png" width="512"></object></p> </code <b Expected Results:</b The value of src attribute appears so that we can manipulate the value. <b Actual Results:</b The src attribute disappears. <b Environment:</b OmegaT: 3.0.4 Up

#860 (2013-05-16) Do not translate style footer information from ODS files [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] I usually convert XLS files received from clients to ODS format and then translate them in OmegaT, but I always see the following segments at the end which look like a file footer with page numbering, although the file has none although this doesn't happen if convert XLS to XLSX and use it in OmegaT: ??? Page <t0 1</t0 <t0 ???</t0 <t1 ???</t1 <t0 00/00/0000</t0 , <t1 00:00:00</t1 Page <t0 1</t0 /

#845 (2013-04-11) Warn user when deselecting project-specific segmentation and file filters [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] At present, in OmegaT 3.0, segmentation rules and file filter settings that are accessed via the "Edit project" dialog the project properties dialog are project-specific. The user can't make any changes to those settings until he selects the check box "Make ... project specific". If the user deselects that option again, then the project-specific settings are no longer applied to the project. Howev

#829 (2013-03-13) Ignore hidden text in DOCX or ODT [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] Many other CAT tools have ways to exclude text from the translation of e.g. a DOCX file, and one of the ways they do it is to ignore hidden text. It would be great if OmegaT could also have the option to ignore hidden text. This will allow users to set the font of things in the file that they do not with to be translated as "hidden" before they feed it into OmegaT.
#823 (2013-02-18) Accept source data from clipboard [File filters & formats] Accept the contents of the clipboard as translatable contents. Useful to translate contents in files that have no filters.

#812 (2012-12-07) Add common file extensions in File Filters dialog [File filters & formats] [Search & replace] Suggestion: Add another column in the File Filters dialog that shows the most common file extensions for each filter. I realise that anyone can see the file extensions by simply opening a filter setting individually, but I think many users recognise file types by their file extension and not by the actual name. This will help users to find the relevant file filter more quickly. It should be a sepa

#795 (2012-07-21) PO files handling improvements [File filters & formats] [Team projects & repositories] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Things I would like to see improved when working with PO files: 1 . don't treat header as a normal translatable segment - skip it and don't show it in the translation pane, instead add related options team, team e-mail address, translator etc. to the filter options dialog and change variable edit related fields like po-revision-date automatically 2 . add an option to limit line length, this should

#782 (2012-05-18) Defaults for Project Properties File Locations [File filters & formats] [Glossaries & terminology] [Dictionaries] [Translation memory & matches] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] Main idea: Allow defaults to be set for the following file locations in the Project Properties dialog: Translation Memory, Glossary, Dictionary Possible implementation: Add tick boxes next to the relevant file location fields in the Project Properties dialog that will allow you to set the filepath currently entered in the field as a default value that will be used to auto-populate that field when

#772 (2012-04-24) Format Latex target files to a maximum line length [File filters & formats] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] [Documentation & localisation] Needed: A modification to the Latex in/output filter: Automatic formatting of the translated target to a certain line length e.g. 76 characters . In addition, an exception for verbatim environments as described in issue 3520937 . Details: I need to comply with a documentation review process requiring the translated target files to be formatted to a linelength of 76 characters to be human readable.

#771 (2012-04-24) Preserve linebreaks in Latex verbatim environment [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] [Documentation & localisation] [Installation & platform] Hi ! Could the Latex in/output filter be modified to keep the linebreaks within a verbatim environment? Details: We use the standard Latex verbatim environment a lot, for example to exactly quote output from an installation. However, all linebreaks within the verbatim statements are gone in the target file, causing a mess in the final document. Running fmt afterwards is no help, I need to preserve

#756 (2012-01-30) Add business rule: source language != target language [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] It is currently possible to have the same language/culture in both source and target in the omegat.project. Expectation: it is not possible to specify this. During opening the project, the project properties window opens and signals the problem.

#695 (2011-07-15) Hidden rows in Excel [File filters & formats] Hi, it would be useful to have an option inside the Microsoft Office XML format filter to make translatable or not hidden rows in an Excel file. It's against best practices, but some clients send us Excel files with hidden rows and ask us not to translate them, making our life quite difficult. I've attached a very simple sample file. Any Excel with one or more hidden rows will do. Tks Marco Cevoli

#648 (2010-10-27) Respect spacing before and after comments in HTML [File filters & formats] Problem: At the moment, if the HTML file looks like this: 12 spaces <td>12345</td> hardreturn 12 spaces < !-- <td>The rain in Spain falls mainly on the plains.</td> --> hardreturn 12 spaces <td>The rain in Spain falls mainly on the plains.</td> hardreturn Then OmegaT will change it to this: 12 spaces <td>12345</td>< !-- <td>The rain in

#621 (2010-05-21) Segment existing translations in PO files [File filters & formats] [Alignment] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] if PO file already contains the target information, the pair msgid "..." msgstr "... " is inserted into the TM, even if the contents are well separable segments, for instance: msgid "Me. Tarzan. You Jane" msgstr "Moi Tarzan. Toi Jeanne" When the segments get adressed during the translation, they get hit not as 100%, but only as fuzzy matches Me. Tarzan >> fuzzy match to "Moi Tarzan. Toi Jean

#615 (2010-05-06) Translate or not "summary" and "alt" in (X)HTML [File filters & formats] [Documentation & localisation] "summary" and "alt" attributes are found in the OmegaT documentation but cannot be excluded from the translatable strings in neither XHTML or HTML filters.

#531 (2009-05-04) project stats details [File filters & formats] [Statistics & counting] The project stats should give details of what comes into the count, per file. For ex, X HTML files could come with the count for all the parsed attributes: "contents", "alt", along with the text contents. That would help providing customers a more detailed/accurate evaluation of the work.

#498 (2009-01-14) Framemaker MIF [File filters & formats] Being able to translate InDesign INX Files is very helpful using Rainbow to convert them to Xliff . But Framemaker is used quite a bit as well, so a filter for this type of file would be great MIF files . Let me know if you need sample files, I'm not a programmer but I'd be happy to help with testing or providing files. Regards, Marco J. Villar mjv196@gmail.com

#464 (2008-07-22) XML: resolve XInclude automatically [File filters & formats] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Hello, as I noticed OmegaT can be used to translate modular documents which are composed using the XInclude standard. After trying a few things I came across a few issues which I will try to describe on DocBook examples: - The whole document is not displayed but only particular files this is ok, when there is a possibility to switch between files . If for example I have a book which uses XInclude

#449 (2008-05-27) Add "import files" button to Project properties dialog [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] When a new project is created, it is logical to add files directly from the propertoes windows than to be first told that the project is empty... A button close to the "source browse" item would greatly enhance the workflow.

#446 (2008-04-23) iWorks suite format support [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] The iWorks suite from Apple has significant OOXML import support and "normal" MS format export support. It would be interresting to have OmegaT support its file format. The structure is simple I can provide test files if/when necessary : For the "Pages" word processor: filename.pages is a folder that contains: /Contents/ Pkinfo non translatable file /Quicklook/ thumbnails index.xml.gz The translat

#442 (2008-03-29) Add XLIFF format to valid formats for TMs [File filters & formats] [Translation memory & matches] [Project handling & files] There's not much if any difference between the TMX format that's accepted for auxiliary translation memories , i.e. in ~/TM/ subdirectory, and the XLIFF format. So far the XLIFF files have been accepted correct my if I am wrong only as input, i.e. as to-be-translated files only. This pretty much misses the whole point of XLIFF as the TM carrier. Giving XLIFF file format and LISA the attention they

#342 (2007-06-19) InDesign inx file filter [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] InDesign is turning into one of the most widely used DTP tools. To translate its files, one may export them to InDesign Exchange or inx files and use Trados TagEditor. Unfortunately, this brings loads of problems because of Trados version diversity. It would be gorgeous to translate these inx with OmegaT.

#331 (2007-04-12) Quick preview (in HTML) [File filters & formats] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Suggested off list: A quick preview of the state of the translation could be output to HTML as a table similarly to what Heartsome's XLFEdit generates : seg nb / uniq / source / target background color could vary depending on the segment status: -translated -source=target -not translated tags could also be output in colors to ease the ckecking process. A "uniq" flag could be set to identify the se

For

Portugese, in which language foreign words are always italicised. OmegaT could have the following shortcuts: CtrlCmd+I - Italic CtrlCmd+U - Underline CtrlCmd+B - Bold These are

In a segment like: <f0>blablabla0 </f0><f1>blablabla1</f1><f2> blablabla2.</f2> where <f0> and <f2> refer to the exact same code, OmegaT should instead display: <f0>blablabla0 </f0><f1>blablabla1</f1><f0> blablabla2.</f0&gt

#116 (2005-11-22) Generic tagged-text filter [File filters & formats] [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] This has been discussed on the OmTDev list, where JC said that smart sentence segmentation could also work, but I disagree... since sentence segmentation would still add everything to the TM instead of just the text itself. == Would it be possible for OmegaT to support a tagged- text type of our own design? I'm thinking about a format in which OmegaT leaves everything that is tagged untouched and

#101 (2005-11-03) Html files parsing and sentence segmentation [File filters & formats] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] We already found that some use of sentence segmentations could help with html parsing for ex <br...> Right now, OmegaT transforms html tags to an OmegaT shortened version before applying the sentence segmenting rules. This process makes implementation of fine grained rules very difficult since complex tags existing in HTML will be reduced to a one character OmegaT tag with an arbitrary numbe

Description: OmegaT’s current statistics feature provides an Exact match category that includes both default and alternative translations. In some workflows, translators are compensated differently for what certain CAT tools refer to as 100% and 101% matches. Having

Go to a segment that is pre-translated with an enforced match 2. Edit the segment Expected results The target text is locked, and no edits are possible.

#1736 (2024-01-29) Alternative translation highlight [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] Background information Information about alternative translation status is stored in SegmentBuilder instances for each segment. Currently it's not possible to access those instances outside of EditorController besides currently active segment. This fact prevents plugin or script creation working with alternative translation status. Proposition An ability to highlight alternative translation in the

#1735 (2024-01-09) Implement accurate and clear fuzzy matching logic [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] Current behaviour Fuzzy matches: - use a rigid diff algorithm based on full tokens that doesn't provide an accurate similarity index - have a complex triple score that is confusing for many users, e.g. 100/100/100% . In practice, this means that often minor differences will prevent displaying matches at all. See the following example: an spelling update in the translation files "practice" - "pract

#1718 (2023-10-02) Calculating match statistics from the command line [Translation memory & matches] [Statistics & counting] [Scripting, plugins & automation] Being able to interface with OmegaT from the command line is helpful when carrying out batch processing. At the moment, it is possible to use the command line to calculate flat statistics using the below option. --mode-console-stats However, it would be very helpful if it were also possible to calculate match statistics in a similar way from the command line, in other words, to generate the same d

Steps Open the Text Search dialog. Type 'bar' . Press Search Desired results Results will include: -- 1 Foo ‘bar’ qux. Actual results Results will not include the segment above. Proposal UI Add the following option to the Text Search dialog: ☑️ Straight quotes match curly quotes Behaviour If the option is checked: -

But any change here is not reflected in the TM, and it is cumbersome and time-c

Add the translated XLIFF file to an OmegaT project. 2. Enable the Okapi XLIFF filter. Current behaviour - The first translation i.e. "1. foo - bar" becomes the default translation. - All the other entrie

Often clients or agencies need to provide instructions to the translators or reviewers about style, voice and tone, clarifications, etc. In OmegaT it has been a frequent request from many users to be able to add non-editable translation notes to specific segments but it is virtually im

#1592 (2021-09-21) Option to choose how matches are sorted (asc or desc) [Translation memory & matches] [UI, windows & usability] Current behaviour TMX files are sorted in the Matches pane by their filename in ascending alphabetical order from 0 to 9, then from A to Z, then from a to z . On the other hand, in OmegaT 5.5.0, the match OmegaT choses to use as the translation is the first one from the top and rightly so . For example where "source target" : 1. Blabla Bar <100/100/100% enforce 2015.tmx 2. Blabla Foo <100/100/100%

#1510 (2020-08-17) Option to hide tags in fuzzy match pane [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, if the fuzzy match contains tags, the tags are displayed in the fuzzy match pane, even if a the source text is a file format that has no tags and even if b the project is set to remove all tags. I suggest to add an option that would hide the tags in the fuzzy match pane. This would be useful for 1. projects where tags are removed, for2. file types that do not use tags, and for 3. people

Once the translation is amended, if the translator wants have an up-to-date TM, they either have to correct the translation manually within the project maybe by copy-pasting segments or to use alignment tools, which in both cases is time consuming and, in the latter case, create different TMs

Provided it does not exist yet, my request is the following: Is it possible to implement in the structure of the file the Source File name and the Target File name for each aligned segment the way SDL Trados does it? As OmegaT

#1459 (2019-07-28) Continue Translation in Other CAT Tools [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] Hi there, As OmegaT has no intermediate files like .SDLXLIFF, it is not easy to use other CAT tools to handle OmegaT projects. I come up with a way which is to use script to export all the segments and after these are translated with other tools, put the final translation memory file to /tm/auto. I wish there is a more convenient way to do this. Thanks. Lihang Xu

"At

#1433 (2019-04-08) Colour code for auto-populated segments [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Sometimes you receive xliff files where most of the segments already are translated in the source. It would be helpful to distinguish them visually from the ones the translator translates from scratch. This is already a feature in DGT- OmegaT colour codes and additions in the editor . Thanks!

#1402 (2018-08-25) Display 100% matches when "Autopropagation of translation" is unchecked [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] When an already translated non unique segment is entered and "autopropagation of translations" is off, the translated match is not displayed in the match pane. #1232 (2016-04-19) Explicitly disallow projects where source language == target language [Translation memory & matches] Users can create projects where the source language and target language are the same. This seems like it works but then saved translations are unable to be loaded correctly because the TMX reader can't figure out which variant is which. We should explicitly blow up on project creation and open if the source and target languages are the same, until/unless we decide to support such a setup for whate

#1230 (2016-04-09) Ensure /tm/enforce, /tm/auto content is persisted in project_save.tmx in all cases [Translation memory & matches] [Documentation & localisation] Per documentation: 337 currently TMs in /tm/auto and /tm/enforce appear to be applied to a project right away, but their content is not actually persisted in project save.tmx until the user does something that counts as a "change" creates a new translation or modifies an existing one . This is surprising and difficult to reason about, as the difference in states is not apparent without manually in

#1228 (2016-04-07) Ignore user-defined text during matching, via regex [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] This RFE is different from RFE 1207 but it tries to solve the same problem in a different way. Sometimes, the text in a document is highly similar to text in a TM, from a reader's or translator's perspective, but not so highly similar from a strictly mathematical matching perspective. This may be because the source text or the TM entry contains or do not contain tag-like structures, or because the

#1227 (2016-04-07) Allow automatic exact match insertion, with prefix [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] Currently, the user can opt to have the best fuzzy match automatically inserted into an empty segment. The user can select the fuzzy match percentage threshold, and can specify a prefix to be added to the inserted match. It is conceiveable that a user might also want exact matches to be inserted in the same way. However, since this feature makes use of the fuzzy match percentage, it is unable to d

#1226 (2016-04-07) Select which fuzzy percentage for fuzzy match insertion [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, when the user uses fuzzy match insertion in the Editing Behaviour Options dialog , OmegaT uses only one of and only a specific fuzzy match percentage out of the three match percentages that are shown in the Fuzzy Matches pane. However, depending on the type of text and language combination it may be more suitable for a translator if OmegaT could use one of the other fuzzy match percenta

#1207 (2016-03-28) Treat custom tags as OmegaT tags when calculating match estimates [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] Custom tags are considered normal text and as such are considered when calculating similarity between a match and a segment. Comparing Lotteries with <b Lotteries</b you get 33,33,12. Comparing <b Lotteries</b with <b Bricks</b you get 66,66,87. It would be useful to improve leverage for such short segments if custom tags could be considered as regular OmegaT tags, so that the match estimates woul

#1172 (2016-01-08) Allow editing of project_save.tmx segments (including orphan) from within OmegaT [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] This RFE follows Make it possible for a user to edit a segment in the main TM project save.tmx from within OmegaT. This may be useful if the main TM contains orphan segments in which errors are spotted during fuzzy matching. It would also make it simpler to fix errors in the current project if those errors are spotted when a match appears in the fuzzy match pane. Although this would normally be us

#1117 (2015-08-23) Ability to Prevent a Segment from Entering the Translation Memory [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] It would be useful to be able to prevent a segment a translation from entering the TM. This can be useful to prevent cluttering TM with useless or occasional translations.

#1089 (2015-05-11) Add exclusion list to tm folder [Translation memory & matches] [Team projects & repositories] [Project handling & files] Having the ability to exclude files/folders within the /tm/ folder from being processed, in the same manner now possible with the /source/ folder would help users managing a single repository of TMXs to select only relevant TMs for their projects.

#1052 (2015-01-07) Exclude segments where source = target from matches and searches [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] This is related to a previous request Having segments in a project or TM containing source = target creates irrelevant results in fuzzy matches and searches. This is a request to add an option in the Search and Fuzzy Matches functions to make OmegaT exclude segments where source = target from results, when checked. For searches, this option would appear in the Search window. For fuzzy matches, thi

The TU's whose source is found in the project, but the text of whose target is different, can be either merged silently, or with user interaction through SuperTMXMerge interface. If the TU's with changed target don't have timestamp/ID, the date of merging and the

#913 (2013-11-12) "Create Translated Document" should create TMXs just for the current document [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] "Project- Create Translated Document" could also create the exported TMX files just for that document, not for the entire project. One application could be doing QA on the exported TMX file of the current file only. We already have similar functionality with the Kos's script, but doing this with a shortcut might be easier. I also think it's logical to make TMX export consistent with the actual fun

Match statistics calculates all of those those, but there is no way to identify or so

For ex. when a segment is inserted from a TM, OmegaT could automatically remove all the tags that are not present in source, or have the user do that via an Edit menu item. The function could be "smart": 1 remove extra tags that are at the ends of th

#837 (2013-03-22) Highlight active match in MatchesTextArea [Translation memory & matches] [UI, windows & usability] Change the highlighting of the active match in MatchesTextArea as follows: 1 . set the source in bold. 2 . set the translation in regular font. 3, set the additional data in gray italics. 4 . set the whole active match in a different color as if it were selected .

A user might want to query a set of TMs but do not wish to use those TMs as reference/legacy TMs and get fuzzy matches from them.
