For ex, a string that has a lot of noise in the match tags and or numbers can be a 100% match but if its matching "profile" is 100%/100%/5% I'd rather have it not inserted automatically. On the contrary, a matchin

#558 (2009-10-18) Suggest matches from http://open-tran.eu [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Documentation & localisation] this website and the people behind collect translations form some big open source projects, it would be nice if OmegaT could provide the possibility to make use of these existing translations. Different examples how to use their API are on so i suppose it will be rather easy to add this service. Best Thomas Zahreddin

#527 (2009-04-01) Add TMX to formats processed by search in files [Translation memory & matches] [Team projects & repositories] [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] Currently, the function of searching in files processes only the file types that OmegaT can use as source files. However, OmegaT also reads TMX files. It would be nice to add TMX to the searcheable formats, thus making it possible to search in TMX repositories which are not added as reference ones in the project properties.

#520 (2009-02-27) Cursor to start of line when fuzzy inserted [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] When OmT automatically inserts the best fuzzy match, the cursor ends up at the end of the segment. A fuzzy match is one that should still be edited, and most ? translators edit from the start, not from the end. So I think that when automatic fuzzy match insertion is done, the cursor should be at the start of the segment or, if possible after the fuzzy marker . --leuce

#502 (2009-01-21) reference TM/TU marking [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] External matches that show up in the matching pane should be available for marking. That could be used when a match is considered as needing some editing. Later, a TMX editor should be able to leverage this information.

#465 (2008-08-11) Consider numbers for fuzzy matches [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] to reproduce: 1 . use the attached po file and tmx in a new project result: the entry '2007-11-25' does not get any suggested translation, although it is contained in the TM expected result: '25.listopadu 2007' suggested as a translation what I saw: nothing

#459 (2008-07-02) Export TMX encoding [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] TMX 1.4 says: 1.2. Character Encoding TMX files are always in Unicode. They can use either of three encoding methods: UTF-16 16-bit files , UTF-8 8-bit files or ISO-646 a.k.a. US-ASCII 7-bit files . In all cases, unlike in HTML, only the following five character entity references are allowed: &amp; & , &lt; < , &gt; > , &apos; ' , and &quot; " . For 7-bit files, extended

#406 (2007-12-13) Numbers mismatching [Translation memory & matches] [UI, windows & usability] In Japanese, months are written: 1 gatsu 2 gatsu 3 gatsu etc... gatsu corresponds to one Japanese character. The fact that OmegaT does not take into account numbers in the matching process results in such strings to match the first that appears in the TM: 2 gatsu will be matched by 1 gatsu even though there is a match including the proper 2 gatsu string. The expected behavior would be that when Om

#389 (2007-10-16) access to match values [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] Access to matching values: -minimum matching percentage -maximum number of matches etc Should be available from the preference file. No need for a fancy GUI to access them, only a text editor would be enough to allow the translator to change them to fit her needs. JC

#368 (2007-09-27) Option: no 100% match for single words [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Documentation & localisation] [Installation & platform] How about adding an option so that segments consisting of a single word wouldn't be considered as 100% matches? If they are, there is a higher risk of translation errors in cases where the same word might have different translations in different contexts. Like English words such as "update" which could be either a noun or a verb. If the user wants to be secure, they could set an option that they w

#343 (2007-06-27) unlimited "cancel" and "revert" functions [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] it should be possible to cancel any action in OmegaT, besides for editing in the target field. this unlimited cancel should allow to go back to the beginning of the session and revert all the segments to the state they were before modification. Similarly, there should be a "revert" function that reloads the project with the TMX created at project launch the most recent backup . The revert function

#327 (2007-03-02) settings for level1/level2/omegat TM export. [Translation memory & matches] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] 1 the exported TMs do not serve anymore as backup TMs but only as reference TMs for further works and for sharing, hence, their creation should not be automatic. ->add a menu command to create export TMs 2 the exported TMs contents vary with the contents of /source/ ->add a time stamp to their name 3 the exported TMs can be used as reference TMs for other projects. If they were created in a

#323 (2007-02-23) Short string match mode [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Documentation & localisation] This feature request was prompted by a post " OmT new user - translation memory & fuzzy matching question" by huda sarfraz@yahoo.com on the Yahoogroup on 23 February 2007, about poor matches on short segments. Different text types do better with different match policies. For general texts, the length of the match should be roughly the length of the current segment. For l10n purposes, however, a tr

#295 (2006-12-13) Match insertion with and without marker [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] Currently, a user can select a certain threshold above which the best fuzzy match is automatically inserted, along with a marker by default, fuzzy . However, there are cases where a responsible user do not want such markers inserted. I propose therefore that there be two options for inserting a best fuzzy match, with individually customisable percentage thresholds and two individually customisable

#280 (2006-11-29) Native import/reading of Wordfast TMs [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] The Wordfast TM format is open and simple -- yes, there are tools to convert WF TM into TMX, but why not make OmT capable of importing the WF TM directly? It doesn't have to be a comprehensive import; after all, the OmT TM doesn't have timestamps or creator IDs or usage stats in it, so the import would be fairly simple and lossy . It would turn this: 20061127~222827 tab SM tab 0 tab EN-ZA tab Usin

#256 (2006-11-19) best match display order [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] with 2 identical %, prefer the one with less word to delete more words to add ex: for: Total Characters including spaces prefer 2 instead of 1 1 Total Characters without spaces 全体文字数（空白を除き） < 75% > 2 Characters including spaces 文字数（空白を含め） < 75% > In the case of 1 "without" has to be erased and replaced by "including". In the case of 2 only "Totla" has to be added at the head of the lin

#254 (2006-11-15) export the TMs with a time stamp etc. [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Project handling & files] Currently the export TMs are overwritten each time since they have a generic name. Since we are discussing modification of the language tags, I think it is important to offer the possibility possibly by default to have at least a time stamp on the exported TMs so as to create a unique name that allows the files to not be overwritten. I am thinking: -change the name of the "tm" folder to "imported

#248 (2006-11-08) Extract Allword TM from large TM or number of TMs [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] This is another low priority RFE, which is really only useful for a project manager. It is in the same vein as RFE 1592823 "Extract Tiny TM from large TM or number of TMs", but produces a larger TM that is potentially more useful. Even if reference TMs produce no fuzzy matches, the TUs in them can still be useful for finding out how words or phrases were translated, if the translator uses OmegaT's

#247 (2006-11-08) Extract Tiny TM from large TM or number of TMs [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] This RFE can have a low, low priority. Let's call the function "Create Tiny TM" or "Minimise Ref TM" or similar. How it works: Basically, when the user selects this function, OmegaT creates a new reference TM containing all segments from the other references TMs that are either exact or fuzzy matches for segments in the current project. Potential usefulness: A user or a project manager might end u

#234 (2006-10-31) Recordable matching rules in Search [Translation memory & matches] [Glossaries & terminology] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] from the exchange related in part 2: when two fields are implemented: JC: ---------------------- With this we could record "rules" accessible from a dropdown menu. Such rules could be used to validate typological rules etc or even glossary items in which case some glossary items could be flagged in the glossary for automatic rule creation et voilà ! ----------------------

#216 (2006-09-15) using back up project TMX files [Translation memory & matches] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Project handling & files] At each reload of the project, OmegaT should take into account the backup TMXs in /omegat/ That way, in case the project save.tmx file gets corrupted, users can have access to old data automatically.

#147 (2006-01-25) Shortcut for quick replace with/insert of a fuzzy match [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Corrently, you have first to select a fuzzy match with Ctrl+<number> and then press Ctrl+R to replace the edited field content with the match or Ctrl+I to insert. It would be nice to have shortcuts for quick replace/insert, such as: - Shift+Ctrl+<number> to replace with the match with the given number; - Alt+Ctrl+<number> to insert the match with the given number. P.S. Unfortunat

#135 (2005-12-22) Customize fuzzy matches engine [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] 1 add: number of displayed matches 2 add: minimal match ratio for display 3 add: ability to compute the match ratio not as: nb of common words/chars divided by nb of words/chars of longest string but as : nb of common words/chars divided by nb of words/chars of shortest string to have better segment part matching That could be called: favor full string matches/favor sub string matches

#88 (2005-09-20) Colouring simultaneously all matches [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Curently only the selected match gives color indication of matching parts in the segment. This color information should be given simultaneously by all the matching segments displayed so that the user can easily determine the matching segment with the most interesting recyclable parts.

#86 (2005-09-20) segment display in match window [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] although visually redundant, the matched segment and the matching segment could be displayed one above the other with clear color indication of what is common and what is not. going from the main window to the match window to try to appreciate differences is not efficient enough.

#85 (2005-09-20) Allow a different font size in match window [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] font size settings in main window and in match find etc windows could be set separately.

#81 (2005-09-19) Matches on subparts of a segment [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] A segment qwertyuiop@ is matched to a segment qwertyuiopasdfghjkl only if the match is over the minimum match display % 30? Similarly, two segments like : qwertyuiop@ and asdfghjkl would not trigger anything special against qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm,. since each subsegment is only matched below 30% to the bigger one, when it is clear that the bigger one is mostly a recombination of two already ex
Editor & segmentation — 78 tickets, 27 upvotes, 304 comments
g.text: Editor & segmentation (78)

g.title: #1788 (2025-09-25) Alert users if Editor pane is minimized [Editor & segmentation] [Spelling, tags & QA] [UI, windows & usability] Some OS window settings trigger a minimization of all the panes in OmegaT. Users who are not used to OmegaT think the project has failed to load and do not know how to handle the issue. OmegaT should test the state of the Editor pane and send an alert to the user with the possibility to reinitialize the pane layout.

#1768 (2024-11-13) Make the segment marker customizable in Preferences [Editor & segmentation] Request Add a <segment marker template node to omegat.prefs so that the user can customize the segment marker. Foreseen placeholders with whatever names : ${segmentNumber} ${repetitionsCountAll} ${repetitionsCountOther} Default Related discussions - Omegat-users Segment marker templates - Omegat-users Segment marker, e.g. <segment 0020 +1 more

#1698 (2023-05-08) Limit for characters in translation (per segment) [Editor & segmentation] [Statistics & counting] Hello, my request is to add character limit per segment. OmegaT already provides character counter in the right-down corner of the program, so I can always see if my translation is longer than original text or not. But I would like an option to globally block myself from putting a translation longer than original text. For example if I'm translating from english and the segment is "Dog", I would l

#1686 (2023-03-07) Use auto-completion in Note Pad [Editor & segmentation] [Glossaries & terminology] The Note Pad could benefit from accessing the Auto-Completion features, for ex. to flag users with auto-text, or to insert glossary item contents as reference, etc.

#1642 (2022-10-25) "Insert the source text" available from the Option or Edit menu [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Some documents have whole parts where the source does nor require much if any modifications. Having access to that option right from the menus would ease the task of shifting from one mode insert to the other don't insert .

#1581 (2021-07-13) Adding a few capitalization styles [Editor & segmentation] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] Right now you can change the text capitalization in the Editor pane by clicking F3. It would be great if this behaviour could be customized, by adding a few capitalization styles such as the ones you can find here: so that you can change a sentence to the capitalization style you need in a given project.

#1574 (2021-06-08) Shortcut to call the Editor window to the front [Editor & segmentation] [Search & replace] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] When many windows are open searches, project files the OS generally provides a method to navigate the windows and go back to one of them, but being able to call the Editor back to the front from any other window would be a nice navigation shortcut.

#1565 (2021-05-05) Give each segment a unique ID [Editor & segmentation] [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] Background Alternative translations aka ICE matches in other CAT tools rely on context in OmegaT. What "context" is depends on what the file filter offers. By default it is the previous and the next segments plus the optional filename . That is indeed the only possibility for documents that do not have internal segmentation and that therefore do not have internal segment IDs Word, text, etc. , and

#1552 (2021-02-18) Add project-specific option for source text insertion [Editor & segmentation] [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] Currently, there is a global option whether OmegaT should insert the source text into a non-translated segment or leave it blank. It would be good to have such an option also on a project-specific level for projects that for some reason require a different approach than a global one. Initially the project-specific option could follow the global settings and could be changed during initial setup of

#1527 (2020-11-27) Do not export untranslated segments [Editor & segmentation] [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] Introduction Since inline codes can be required to produce structurally valid target files, below I use two examples: a generic text-only Doc1 and one HTML Doc2 with some tags. Preconditions Original sample files: Doc1: This is sentence one. This is sentence two. This is sentence three. Doc2: And <b one two! Three four</b ! <br/ A project where some segments are not translated. Doc1: 1 s: This is

#1480 (2019-12-30) Delete paragraph symbol in segment marker [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] I have updated from OmegaT 4.1.4 to 5.1 0. Now, in some segments I get this kind of thing: <segmento 4873 ¶ Is this paragraph sign marking the end of a paragraph? I understand "View Mark paragraph delimitations" which I have deactivated serves that purpose, so I am a bit confused about the meaning of that added "¶". In any case, if possible, it would be fantastic to have one of that lovely "applic

#1458 (2019-07-20) Edit current segment's note in a dialog window [Editor & segmentation] [Glossaries & terminology] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] In projects where translators need to add a lot of notes it's somewhat time consuming to move the focus into the Notes pane, and then back to the Editor. It would be great to have a way to call up a popup window where the current segment's note could be added/edited. The user would press the shortcut combination, a window similar to "Create glossary entry" would appear with focus set to it. If the

#1453 (2019-06-22) Iterator [Editor & segmentation] Many times it is necessary to edit a bunch of adjacent segments in the same way this is, applying the same event . For this reason, I think it would be nice to have an in-built iterator in OmegaT that allows to repeat in a loop some of the most frequent tasks. This kind of idea: ! !

#1424 (2019-02-26) Possibility to move <segment marker> to a new line [Editor & segmentation] It would be nice to be able to move the segment marker below the target or above the source to have a clearer way to visually compare source and target. It would look like this: ----- Source text. Target text. <segment ----- <segment Source text. Target text. ----- This option should be configurable in Preferences - Editor -- Kos

#1370 (2018-02-27) "Last/Most Used" Character Line in Autocomplete [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It might be useful to have a separate line of last and/or most used characters in Autocomplete window. This line could be located over the character table. For example, I mostly use the 'degree' character, so it would be nice to have it above the table in a separate row.

#1353 (2017-11-13) Desire to disable unneccesary scrolling when double-clicking a segment [Editor & segmentation] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] I would like to be able to disable the -- to me -- unneccessary massive scrolling of text in Editor when double-clicking a segment which is more at the top or bottom of the editing window. I find the moving of the editable segment to dead center of the Editing window somewhat unnecceary and irritating. I seem to loose the visual focus of the segment when it jumps far away from under the mouse curs

#1352 (2017-11-13) Text cursor visible only on active Segment in Editor [Editor & segmentation] I'd wish that - while already having an active segment elsewhere in Editor - a single-click of a mouse on a non-active "yellow" segment would not show a visible cursor on this passive segment. To me cursor sort of invites me to type in text, yet it will be inserted in the active segment elsewhere. I for one do tend to forget it, as the flashing cursor seems so tempting... I'd also wish that the te

#1348 (2017-10-31) Czech Segmentation Rules [Editor & segmentation] I think Czech segmentation rules should be included in future releases. The DGT-OmegaT Czech portion of their segmentation.conf works very well; however, if you do not want overlap, I have been making my own set of rules which so far work 100% - I would like to add a set of common abbreviations I have not yet encountered and then I think it would be ready for a general release, although the result

#1336 (2017-09-29) Add Absolute Position Indicator before "File Translated / Number of Segments" [Editor & segmentation] [Statistics & counting] [UI, windows & usability] It would be helpful to have an indication of the current absolute position in the translated file like "N/M", where 'N' is the total numer of segments in the translated file, and 'M' sequence number of the current currently opened segment, and/or a percent value before "file translated / number of segments" statistics in the lower right corner of the main window. My personal view is that "file tra

#1324 (2017-06-28) Display soft line breaks [Editor & segmentation] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] Hi, I was testing some documents in OmegaT 3.6.0 5. I found a problem with soft line breaks. I have a document with two sentences. In every sentence is a soft line break see screenshot "source document" but you cant find it in the editor see screenshot "weicher Zeilenumbruch in OmegaT" Best Ines

#1309 (2017-02-27) Base history prediction on more words [Editor & segmentation] Currently, History prediction seems to consider only one word to predict what follows that word, but it would be even more useful if it could use 2 or more past words to compute the predictability order. In the case of French, for ex. there are plenty of small words articles etc. that come between words and basing the prediction only on that word make the prediction candidates much more numerous a

#1282 (2016-10-27) Show comments and/or notes as tooltips [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be nice to have Comments and Notes shown as pop-up text on hover-over event for the relevant segments. It would be useful if one needs to check/review all comments and notes without having to enter every annotated segment can be rather time-consuming, if many segments - some of them containing lengthy text - have comments/notes .

#1274 (2016-09-30) Option to accept autocompletion with Tab instead of Enter [Editor & segmentation] Following on this thread: Currently, autocorrect suggestions are accepted with the Enter key, but this is problematic for people who normally use the Enter key to move to the next segment. I propose that it be made possible for the user to choose to use the Tab key instead of the Enter key to accept an autocorrect suggestion.

#1267 (2016-08-29) Dismiss auto-completer after hitting Ctrl+right/left arrow, Home, End [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] A follow-up to 1192 These keys are also often used to move within a segment efficiently, hence it would be useful to dismiss the auto-completer window after hitting them as well.

#1266 (2016-08-20) Placeables auto-completer view [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] There was an inquiry about "placeables" in a user group thread From the discussion it sounds like "important-looking" pieces of text from the source are offered for insertion into the target. The specific example given was that if the source contains "John Smith" then "John Smith" should be offered. It's not clear exactly what criteria should be used for finding placeables, but some possibilities:

#1265 (2016-08-08) Rename "Save" to "Export" in Autotext Configuration dialog [Editor & segmentation] [Search & replace] [Project handling & files] Currently, the "Save..." button in the Autotext Configuration dialog exports the current list of autotext items to a file of the user's choosing, but it doesn't then continue to use that file. I find this counter intuitive. If I "save" a file and continue working, then I would expect to be continuing using the saved file. In other words, the fact that the export button is called "Save..." implies

#1225 (2016-04-06) Review Mode in Editor [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] This request is to implement a "Review Mode" for the Editor pane. The Review Mode will be activated/deactivated from the Menu View Review Mode and it will consist of the following features: By default, the source text, including that for the active segment, will not be displayed. The text will be displayed in "paragraph view", instead of "sentence view", regardless of the segmentation setting for

#1150 (2015-11-08) Shortcut for Auto-sync with Editor [Editor & segmentation] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] On the Search window, I check and uncheck "Auto-sync with Editor" frequently, so it would be helpful to have the following shortcut: Ctrl+W for "Auto-sync with Editor" In fact, "W" is the only option left available.

#1136 (2015-10-04) Do not scroll Editor window when opening a segment [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] When opening a segment in the Editor the window content moves a bit, probably, in order to show the totality of the opened segment or to center it in the window. Is it a bug or a feature? If it is a feature, then, IMHO, it is better to be able to disable this self-centering function in the "Option - Edining Behavior", because sometimes in large and slow projects it becomes inconvenient, as the mov

#1121 (2015-09-07) Preventing segmentation of pre-translated entries [Editor & segmentation] [File filters & formats] When a filter sends pushes an entry, it may provides the translation for that entry e.g. in XLIFF, TXML, etc. . If the project has the segmentation option set, that entry may get segmented and in this case the translation is lost. Maybe the segmenter could check for the presence of a translation before trying to segment, and not segment if there is a translation available. See also this email thre

#1103 (2015-06-23) Double-click on a word should select trailing space [Editor & segmentation] In some other programs e.g. MS Word and some browsers , double-clicking a word selects not only the word itself but also the trailing space but not any trailing punctuation . This is useful when moving words around with drag-and-drop within the editor, because you don't have to add an extra space or fix the doubled space that is left after a word was dragged elsewhere.

#1094 (2015-06-09) Sorting segments [Editor & segmentation] [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] It would be nice if an OmegaT user could sort segments in the Edit pane. Examples of sort would be alphabetical, by length, by translatedness, by tag presence, etc. Sorting by author and modified date would also be very nice. To activate segment sorting, the user would select the option a button or a menu item which would pop up a dialog asking for the sort preferences, and a "Sort" button. Pressi

#1051 (2015-01-06) Mark and go to segments where source=target [Editor & segmentation] [Translation memory & matches] [UI, windows & usability] This request is related to an already implemented request This is a two-part request: 1 To add an option in the View menu: "Mark Identical Segments". The behavior is that OmegaT marks any segments whether auto-populated or not in the Editor where the translation is identical to source with a distinct color. 2 To add two options in the Go To menu: "Go To Previous/Next Identical Segment". The behavi

#1005 (2014-06-21) Modification history per segment [Editor & segmentation] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, only the person who last modified a segment is stored and displayed. With this RFE, OmegaT would add the information it gets from the server and display it in a list above the segment only if "display history" is selected, otherwise it would be too cumbersome? For ex: Translation last modified by jchelary on Jun 20, 2014 at 8:43:30 PM Translation modified by dbriel on Jun 20, 2014 at 8:

#984 (2014-04-11) Autotext strings input dialog [Editor & segmentation] [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] A dialog to input auto-text strings shortcut/text similar to the way the glossary items are input during the translation would make the feature easier to access and use. The option dialog could still be used to manage the current auto-text strings.

#948 (2014-01-26) Capabilities for marking the status of a segment (to be used for proofreading) [Editor & segmentation] [Translation memory & matches] [Statistics & counting] [UI, windows & usability] It would be very useful to have at least basic status options for segments, such as "draft" and "proofread". During proofreading, there is currently no practical way to know which segments have already been proofread. I usually progress linearly, writing in a text editor the last proofread segment. Note that this doesn't necessarily mean that these status options would need to be tied to the TM as

#939 (2013-12-23) Allow defining different font for segment source and target text [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Source text in the editor's active segment is bold by default. This makes complex Chinese characters difficult or impossible to read. Compare the bold and plain versions of, 檀 and 檀, tán 'sandal wood', or 龜 and 龜, guī 'tortoise' as two of thousands of examples of mildly complex Chinese characters. The same applies to the kanji of written Japanese. Because the font size of the target and of the sou

#935 (2013-12-06) Make the Segmentation Rules window size configurable or just larger [Editor & segmentation] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] [Documentation & localisation] Make the Segmentation Rules window size configurable or just larger Problem: The Segmentation Rules window is small and rather inconvenient for use when you try to enter/edit long segmentation rule — you have to expand it manually each time. Suggestion: There could be 2 options: 1. Make this window larger by default. 2. Make this window configurable as for example Search window in the omegat.prefs

#933 (2013-12-06) Keep the author unсhanged upon adding 100/100/100 segments by Ctrl+R if without changes [Editor & segmentation] [Spelling, tags & QA] Problem: Due to the fact that now OmegaT supports several memories there often exists the following situation: in non-auto memory there is 100/100/100 segment, but the author and time is changed upon inserting it into the translation even without changes using Ctrl+R . Suggestion: It would be rather convenient if the OmegaT kept the author and time unchanged upon adding such 100/100/100 segments t

#930 (2013-12-03) Add "Unload" button to autotext dialog [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] Problem: At present, if no autotext file is specified, OmegaT falls back to the default omegat.autotext file. However, if a user has specified an autotext file, OmegaT will always use the user's specified file, until he select another autotext file or removes the autotext file. There is no easy way for the user to tell OmegaT to use the default omegat.autotext file, except by temporarily deleting

#903 (2013-10-15) Provide context in the form of an image [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] We use OmegaT to translate user interfaces of software. On many segments, we have an image that displays the context in the form of the user interface screen in which the text is used. Together with sample data. Each image contains multiple segments. See example. These files are generated automatically by our testing software. It would be nice if we could display in addition to the "key" one or mo

#886 (2013-09-16) Append Notes to segment when creating Target [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] The Notes pane contents could be optionally appended to the attached segment in the Target document with a prefix like translator's note: note content

#868 (2013-05-20) Listing all parallel non-unique segments [Editor & segmentation] [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] Sometimes deciding upon using "Create Alternative translation" or making the current non-unique translation default heavily depends on other non-unique segments and their context that are identical to the current. At the moment the only way to list segments that are the same with the current one is to search for it, making sure the right search options are selected. Besides, if several such segmen

#830 (2013-03-14) Tiled View in Editor [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] Hey, I use OmegaT for translating and have linux on my notebook. It's cool that I've found OmegaT because there are only few applications for translators under linux. But for more comfort during translating I would like to have a tiled view in the editor: One window for the source language segment on the left and another window for the target language on the right. It would be great if it would be

#794 (2012-07-16) Auto fill "number only" segments [Editor & segmentation] It would be nice to have a feature that when marked would fill all the segments that contain numbers only also digits separated by dots, commas or spaces . Now if I translate a table with lots of numbers, I have to go field by field doing Ctrl+Shift+I every time.

#765 (2012-03-12) Ability to mark segments as provisional [Editor & segmentation] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Project handling & files] Problem: If a user is busy translating a segment but is not yet finished with it, and wants to edit some other segment or check something in another file in the project , he must leave the current segment i.e. it is then marked as translated, and will propagate even though he is not finished with it. He could add a mark e.g. to it but if he forgets about it, the mark will end up in his target file

#687 (2011-05-25) Autowrite / Autosuggest when typing [Editor & segmentation] [Translation memory & matches] [Scripting, plugins & automation] You're probably familiar with the automatic suggestion featured by SDL Trados or DejaVu called Autosuggest and Autosuggest . It is defined as sub-segment matching suggestions as you type see or . Of course, it should be optional. If there is an interest for this, I can help you better define the specs. Kind regards Marco Cevoli www.qabiria.com

#683 (2011-03-05) Changing horizontal position of next segment in Editor [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Actually, it seams that when typing the TAB key, the next segment in the editor view is placed in the window with 3 segments before and after. When the window is small or the segments very long, it happens that after the TAB key stroking only the first line of the next segment is visible, and needs scrolling to view or place the actual segment in a convenient part of the window. It could be great

#628 (2010-07-26) Manage different states for segments [Editor & segmentation] [Machine translation] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] On behalf on Martin Kempf in the Yahoo list << There should be more that two states for a segment, “translated” or “untranslated”. There would be for instance “to be reviewed” or “machine translation” or “terms to be researched”. These states would be mainly identified by a coloured border on the left: red for untranslated, orange for a rough or machine translation, yellow for “terms to be r

#583 (2010-02-05) Contextual menu in Editor [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] On current source: - with selection ->copy - without selection -> nothing On other source: - with selection ->copy ->paste overwrites target ->go to segment - without selection ->paste overwrites target ->go to segment In current target: - with selection ->cut ->copy ->paste - Without selection ->paste On other target: - with selection ->copy ->paste overwrit

#577 (2010-01-21) View Only Unique Segments [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be interesting to add an option to view only unique segments. For instance, a file with 100 segments but only 10 unique ones would display 10 segments instead of 100.

#551 (2009-09-18) Save multiple segmentation profiles from within OmegaT [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] 1 . All OmegaT's current segmentation rules are still stored in a single segmentation.conf file, but for this example I'll name it the default.seg file. This way, the way OmegaT stores segmentation rules doesn't change. Only the way they are managed are. 2 . The segmentation dialog remains as it is right now, except that it gets three additional widgets, namely a "Save" button, a "Save as" button

#521 (2009-02-27) Keep inserted text highlighted initially [Editor & segmentation] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] When using a shortcut in OmT to insert a longish piece of text into an existing piece of text, I find it confusing for a moment or two, because I have to mentally repicture the segment to see where the inserted text begins and ends. For some reason I don't have this problem when I use Ctrl+V, but that may simply be because I usually insert single words or very short phrases using Ctrl+V. But when

#480 (2008-10-28) Make segment selection configurable (single vs double click) [Editor & segmentation] [Statistics & counting] [Search & replace] The thing I find most annoying about OmegaT is that you have to double-click on a segment to be able to edit it. Single clicks, no matter how many, are not enough. Sometimes you think you've selected a segment, then you start typing and it goes into wherever your cursor was, not where you want it. Then you have to delete the typing and THEN you need to go back to the segment you wanted to edit and

#470 (2008-09-19) project list data: first segment/last segment [Editor & segmentation] Add a "first segment nb " and "last segment nb " to the data so that it is easier to navigate a single file by using the "Jump" feature.

#437 (2008-03-08) Import/export segmentation rules [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] More and more people are using OmegaT and soon there will be a need to share segmentation rules among colleagues. Currently, all OmegaT segmentation rules are stored in a single file in a fairly inaccessible location. I suggest that OmegaT be able to a limitd set of export segmentation rules and import a limited set into its global segmentation rules set. I think it must be possible to select only

#412 (2007-12-28) Add warning when switching between input files [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Current OmT behaviour: When accepting the translation of the last segment of a file, OmT jumps to the first segment of the following file. Desired behaviour: A message is displayed notifying the user that the last segment of the file has been reached and prompts whether to proceed with the next file: "You have reached the end of the file. Do you want to proceed to next file? Yes/No". Why would thi

#408 (2007-12-16) Improve "Segmentation Setup" for keyboard navigation [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, the "Segmentation Setup" dialog is unfriendly to a keyboard. Pressing TAB lets the focus enter the top part, but then you're stuck in the top list unless you use the mouse to click outside of it. Pressing Shift+TAB takes one to the buttons at the bottom, but if you keep pressing it, the focus goes missing at some point. It is possible to add rules to a rule set by using TAB to reach the

#396 (2007-10-25) Export project and split into parts [Editor & segmentation] A group of translators working on a large project that consist of lots of small files may like this one: Let it be possible for OmegaT to export a single document plaintext, I think that contains all the source text segments of the project. Or better, let it be possible to select how many documents are needed so many co-translators and then OmegaT splits said document into that many parts or split

#394 (2007-10-22) Partial wordcount [Editor & segmentation] It would be nice to be able to select segments and get a partial wordcount for selected items. That might be useful when splitting a large text among translators or if one decides to translate a certain amount of text per day e.g. a 2000 word text to be translated in 4 days, means 500 words per day . It is not a vital feature but it might be useful.

#366 (2007-09-23) Export and import of segments [Editor & segmentation] [Dictionaries] [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] Problem: Sometimes I can do stuff with my translation in some other program better than I can do it in OmegaT. Currently, doing so is a hack -- edit the project save.tmx and use complex regular expressions to ensure I don't break anything. One example is spell-checking. OmegaT has/will have Hunspell-capability, but not all languages have Hunspell-dictionaries, and sometimes the translator may have

#346 (2007-07-04) multi clipboard or auto insert from a list [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] There are translations where inserting a number of very commonly used strings takes a huge amount of time. A multi clipboard function or an auto insert function would be nice in such cases. The user could register "live" the strings to put in the multi clipboard and call them with a relevant shortcut. There are 10 numbers available on most keyboards and sometimes more function keys, so that would

#322 (2007-02-18) add "go to to [..] segment" [Editor & segmentation] [Translation memory & matches] Summary of the current status, other RFEs and new proposed items cf navigation of the pseudo translation in 1374122 : Go to: next segment implemented next untranslated segment implemented next unique segment 1517945 next fuzzy segment 1374122 checks the presence of the fuzzy prefix previous segment implemented previously translated segment 1517945 previous untranslated segment previous unique segm

#318 (2007-02-08) go to preceding untranslated [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] When reviewing untranslated segments it is impossible to go back. A common way to reverse a command is to use a shift prefix, hence shift+mod+u would be perfect to go back to the preceding untranslated.

#311 (2007-01-06) segmentation triggering [Editor & segmentation] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] GUI bug: there is no way to trigger segmentation for the "segmentation..." menu item. one has to go to "properties" and play with the widgets there. there should be a "activate segmentation" widget right on the segmentation rules global window.

#310 (2007-01-06) option: set "move to next untranslated segment" to RETURN [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] With the idea that a translator first translates and then reviews, we could have an option that sets: RETURN=go to next segment or RETURN=go to next untranslated segment somewhere easily accessible and eventually accessible with a shortcut to allow for quick shifting between the two modes . Or we could "hide" the key assignement and just have a: translation mode return goes to next untranslated re

#304 (2006-12-16) Simplify the worflow by putting the "project" concept aside. [Editor & segmentation] I am thinking that a lot of beginners are stuck by the "project" concept. I am more and more seeing the "project" feature of OmegaT as an advanced feature that we should radically simplify to lower the entry level. Like make it "text editor" low... The project is a nice thing when processing multiple files is necessary, but when only one file is involved, having to go through the process of creati

#284 (2006-11-29) docking options for the editor pane [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It looks the editor pane is the only one to have only 2 displacement icons. which practically means that to move it it is necessary to move the other panes around it. I think all the panes should have a equal role in the window, hence adding the docking icon to the editor pane is a necessity.

#267 (2006-11-24) Cursor to middle of target after source insertion [Editor & segmentation] When inserting the source into the target the cursor should not be sent by default to the end of the target segment - Cursor to beginning or middle of the target would be better.

#240 (2006-11-06) Option to display unsegmented text [Editor & segmentation] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] OmegaT currently displays only the segmented text in the Edit pane, based on the file filter. However, I foresee some cases in which the user might want to be able to see the unsegmented text of the file he's translating. One such case might be where the file does not conform 100% to the filter, and the user wants to be able to spot any text that should have been segmented but wasn't. Another migh

#235 (2006-10-31) Identify subflow segments visually [Editor & segmentation] [Spelling, tags & QA] [UI, windows & usability] An ODF file may contain a number of fields including comments for the translator, inserted as notes. OmegaT does not make any difference in the display and sometimes such segments are translated by mistake because they look like translatable text. OmegaT should indicate what is the origine of the segment, maybe by using a different segment tag. <segment 0001> for normal segments <subflow

#212 (2006-09-07) visual identification of "extra" segments [Editor & segmentation] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] Some segments are not part of the visual "flow" of the file: HTML attributes, ODF hidden text etc. Such segments should be identified in the main windows, maybe by using a different background color, so as not to confuse the translator who does not see them in the file.

#182 (2006-05-07) Extracts the content of the projects to text file [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] I was thinking that for textual verifications, it would be interesting to have OmegaT export a text only version of the project/per file eventually. This would serve as a "draft" for the final version and could be used to review the translation in a text only editor to get a feel of the text style/ rendering.

#151 (2006-02-08) Pop question when source is modified outside OmegaT [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] Many text editors have a feature where, if a file has been modified outside the text editor, they ask whether they should reload the file or not. It would be nice if OmegaT has a similar feature, where it asks if the project should be reloaded, if a source file was modified.

#122 (2005-12-02) Let OmT suggest segmentation rule based on current segment [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] If OmT missegmented a sentence usually because of an abbreviation in it , the user has to add a rule to the segmentation rules. But not all users are equally adept with adding rules and knowing the rules syntax. So... have a button or a shortcut that does this: 1 . When a user gets a missegmented sentence, the button makes OmT analyse the current segment's ESP end of segment punctuation and pops u

#119 (2005-11-27) Map "go to next untranslated segment" to a single key [Editor & segmentation] [Translation memory & matches] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] "Go to next untranslated segment" is extremely useful when reviewing a project or updating it which should be the main activity for the TM tool... Regardless the number of updated segments, having a 2 key ctrl+u shortcut to access a function as common as "go to next segment" enter/ return is not ergonomic. Maybe splitting return/enter would be a way to access both: the big key return -> go to n

#80 (2005-09-09) Highlight, word, phrase [Editor & segmentation] Add 'highlight' function.. so as to prevent any missing on doing works. Such as some critical words or phrases are a first entry of 'highlight.' For example: and, or, such, therefore...... Or any arbitrary words or phrases can be enlisted as highlight. You can see 'highlight' in most of programmers editor for compiling.... In this case, main , for loop, and/or each function names are highlighted.

#3 (2004-06-11) Ability to join and break segments [Editor & segmentation] got the following request in OmegaT yahoo group from Micah Bly Hello All. I am a new Omega T user ... I shamelessly have some feature requests: An option to be able to expand the current segment rightwards, to include more, by removing a line break. In case you had a line break in the wrong place. Even when pre-editing files, sometimes these slip by you... And opposite: ability to split a segment

g.title: #1774 (2025-02-09) Adding search and favorite options to Ctrl+Space unicode character dialog [Search & replace] Sometimes it's difficult to find a specific character say "em dash" among those all unicode characters. Therefore, it would be very helpful if users would be able to: 1. search for a character by text 2. favorite characters so that they stay at the top of the dialog to find them easily

#1758 (2024-07-31) Multiple filters (refined search) [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] There was coming one more thing in my mind, if you are already start to work at the filter functionality: Give the option to add more then one filter naming them Filter1, Filter2 etc. , which can also be deleted one-by-one. Scenario: I am searching for a a certain term within a certain section of my document, let's say within a enumeration in my source: First Filter in "source mode": RegEx: ^ d .

#1757 (2024-07-31) Negative search [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] As mentioned in this Request, it would be nice to have a functionality to perform a negative search. Scenario: SourceWord1 has been translated into TargetWord1 which is the preferred one or "accidentally" TargetWord2 or TargetWord3 My use-case: Searching for an occurrence of a certain SourceWord - TargetWord 2,3 combination Filter out all Segments containing that certain SourceWord - TargetWord 2,

#1756 (2024-07-31) Search/Replace within a Filter [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] [Documentation & localisation] As mentioned in this Request it would be nice to have a functionality to perform a search and replace within an already filtered editor pane. My use-case: Searching for an occurrence of a certain SourceWord Filter out all SourceSegments containing that certain SourceWord by setting a Filter Performing a manual replacement segment-by-segment because of lacking functionality to perform a filter-base

#1755 (2024-07-28) More Powerful Search and Replace Filters [Search & replace] [Team projects & repositories] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] Dear OmegaT-Team, I highly appreciate your Application and wish to add a Feature-Request, since I am not figuring out, how to do this job without an implemtation: My job requires to have the same translation of a word over the whole document. If I am working on it for several days, sometime I forgot to keep a new vocabulary at a constant level. For that I have to do a review anyway and often it ap

#1752 (2024-06-26) Dynamic subfilter in text search results [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] Steps Open the text search dialog Ctrl+F and search for, say, string "foo" Results: In a nutshell: too many results. Perhaps I don't need to see them all. Feature enhancement A subfilter box that helps the user reduce the number of results by having a dynamic match. For example, perhaps the user is only concerned with translations in folder abc or Johny , so they should reduce the number of result

#1659 (2022-12-20) click on search result should take the browser to the first occurrence of the query [Search & replace] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] [Documentation & localisation] [Installation & platform] When searching the user manual, clicking on the links in the results should take the browser to the first occurrence of the word you were looking for. Every occurrence seems to be highlighted in the page: <span class="wh-highlighted" install</span One possible solution would be to use javascript to getElementsByClassName and give an id attribute eg firstresult to the second item in the DOM or the

#1651 (2022-11-12) Add ID keys to "search in comments" option [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] See The IDs of a Bundle are not searchable. They should be searchable to exchange information with other translators. Maybe the "search in comments" needs a rewording "search in properties and comments ?" too long ?

#1542 (2021-01-12) Displaying TU/segment attributes in search results [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] In the pane displaying search results, TU/segments attributes, e.g. the change ID or timestamp, are now displayed. It would be a nice feature to have them displayed. Assuming you are searching for a term and getting quite a number of hits, where the term is translated in different ways, displaying TU/segment attributes may facilitate your choice. Please consider.

#1516 (2020-09-11) rename 'Search in comments', it is actually searching in all properties [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] The search window has the option 'Search in comments', but what it does is actually search in all properties. So I'd rephrase it into 'Search in properties'

#1507 (2020-08-15) Search menu presets [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] It would be great to have a drop down menu to select presets in the search window. There are a few settings that I use often and it would make it so much faster if I could easily save them and reuse them. It would also allow me to not miss a segment I'm looking for because I forgot to tick a box when changing the type of text I'm looking for or the target . For example here are some of the "profil

#1501 (2020-07-29) Add "Remove filter" button to Find dialog [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] At this time, there is a "Filter" button on the Find dialog, but you can't use the button more than once without first pressing the "Remove filter" button, which is not on the Find dialog but on the editor. It seems odd that one needs to leave the Find dialog in order to re-activate the "Filter" button on the Find dialog. I suggest adding the "Remove filter" button to the Find dialog next to the "

#1472 (2019-12-08) Replace nulls with a type-safe Optional type [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [Installation & platform] Nulls are a big source of bugs because they surpass type checking enforced by the compiler. Java 1.8 introduced java.util.Optional which can replace the semantics of "something doesn't exist" in a type-safe manner. I propose work be undertaken to replace instances of null with java.util.Optional<T . This will likely break binary compatibility, so it's likelier that if this were introduced, it woul

#1471 (2019-12-06) "Full segment" option in search dialog [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] Scenario: You want to search for segments that contain a sentence or expression. However, that sentence or expression is part of other segments too, and you will get those results too. The online way to exclude those results where there's more text before or after the search expression is to turn that string into a regex and add ^ and $ before and after, respectively. However, the average user doe

#1426 (2019-03-07) Additional Shortcuts for Text Search dialog [Search & replace] [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] The "In notes" and "In comments" checkboxes in the Text Search window currently do not have a shortcut key attached. Please enable Alt+X for "In comments" and Alt+Z for "In notes". The current keyboard mapping in the Text Search and Text Replace dialogs is modifier Alt+ : A Case sensitive B Changed before C Close D Select Folder E Excat search F Files G Glossaries H Author I In translation J Proje

#1416 (2019-01-30) Extend available keyboard shortcuts for Search window [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, in the Search window there are a few mnemonics used for triggering options, and a few predefined shortcuts to perform a few actions. It would be very helpful if what is available as mnemonics and those couple options that didn't get any mnemonics could also be triggered by user-defined shortcuts, and a few new actions added to the window to provide for mouse-free operation. Requested ne

#1392 (2018-06-14) Highlight the searched terms in filter view [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Just like a search term is highlighted when clicking on a matching segment, it would be nice to have all the searched terms highlighted when filtering the view.

#1381 (2018-03-08) Unlimited undo for replacement function [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be nice if one could use Ctrl+Z to undo a replacement. This is how it works for me in e.g. MS Word :- The "undo" function should work at least as long as the Editor pane is filtered for replacements. If the user had used "Replace all", then pressing Ctrl+Z should undo all replacements. If the user had replaced items one by one, then pressing Ctrl+Z should undo them one by one, starting fr

#1380 (2018-03-08) Add a "Find Previous" button to the Search window [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] <s suggest the following changes to the filtered Editor pane after having clicked "Replace" in the Replacement dialog : 1. Change the "Replace Next" button to "Replace Current/Find Next", but keep the button's function the same. 2. Change the "Skip" button to "Find Next", and make sure it's function is to select the next instance of the found text.</s 3. Add a "Find Previous" button, which selects

#1379 (2018-03-08) Improved buttons for Replace function [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] The labels of some of the buttons in the Replace function are confusing or not intuitive. 1. In the Replace dialog, the "Replace" button does not actually replace anything but simply filters the Editor pane. I suggest renaming this button to "Filter" or "Filter replacements". 2. In the filtered Editor pane, the "Replace Next" button does not actually replace the next instance. It sometimes finds t

#1294 (2016-12-23) Automatic search for source text [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be nice to be able to trigger an automatic search whenever the user jumps to a new segment. The automatic search should have default parameters: - keyword search - case insensitive - in source only - search only translated segments - search in Memory and TM The automatic search should reuse the same search window, as opposed to regular searches, which open a new search window each time th

#1278 (2016-10-25) Restricting Search to Current File in Search Window [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be useful, if it were possible to restrict search to curent file by a radio button or a check box in the Search window. The project may and often does contain many files, and I personnally often search for particular terms in the file I'm curently translating. Of course, I can filter the current file from the Search window, but it is much more complicated than simply searching via the Sea

#1233 (2016-04-21) Right-Click Menu in Search Window [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be useful to have in Search window a right-click menu similar to Fuzzy Match panel with, at least, 2 options, i.e. "Insert Match or Selection into Translation", and "Replace Translation with Match or Selection" . That would eliminate 2 keyboard shortcut operations copying some text in Search window and pasting it in Edit panel . The same actions might also be started from the menu bar of

#1163 (2015-11-28) Searching for translation units created before or after a certain date [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] Right now you can search for units changed before or after a certain date. A new option to search for translation units created before or after a certain date would be also useful. The same GUI could be used, just putting the new option next to or below the existing one.

#1162 (2015-11-28) Shortcut for direct search for source text [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be useful to have a shortcut to open the search window and search for the whole source segment, regardless of its content or length, similar to the "concordance search" in other CAT tools. It would also handy if the search is automatically performed without another click be it Enter or clicking on the Search button , provided that the options are correctly set ie: search in source; you mi

#1125 (2015-09-13) Find Next button on Search window [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Thanks to the recent improvement, a search word is automatically selected on the Editor pane when a search is made. What I still miss is the Find Next button and a corresponding shortcut on the Search window. Clicking on this button should result in selecting the next matching word relative to the current cursor position on the Editor; the next match can be either in the current segement or in ano

#1119 (2015-08-31) Showing Segments from Current File First in Text Search Window [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be useful if segments from current file were listed first in the Text Search Window and separated from other files with a separator e.g. a double-dotted line . The project can be very large with many files, and if the name of the current file begins with a letter somewhere in the middle of the alphabet, it is not easy to find segments from this particular file. That would be quicker than

#1115 (2015-08-23) Keeping Selection in the “Search for” Field after a Search [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Problem: After a search, the selection in the search window moves to the field with segments found. Solution: It would be better to keep the selection in the “Search for” field after a search in case we need to modify the string we are searching for.

#1111 (2015-07-15) Add File Name field to Advanced Options in Search window [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, users can filter search results and later select specific files using Project Files to have access to filtered segments per source file. This is a request to add an option to the Advanced Options in the Search window for the user to specify a file name for the search to be performed within a specific file or group of files. For this purpose, the File Name field in the new Advanced Optio

#1079 (2015-04-01) Regexp: clear confusion about case sensitiveness [Search & replace] I'v been using the regexp A-Z + a-z + and was wondering why it wasn't working as I expected. After a while I found out that the "Case sensitive" checkbox was not checked. I find it somehow confusing that the standard behavior is not "case sensitive". I think it would be more clear if the option "case sensitive" is not active when selecting "Regular expressions". Users that still need case insensit

#1060 (2015-02-02) Replace with Source or Selection/Insert Source or Selection [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] It would be nice if Replace with Source/Insert Source would be selection-aware in a manner similar to 1057 i.e. when there's something selected in the source segment, Replace with Source and Insert Source would use only the selected part of the source segment, otherwise Replace with/Insert the whole source segment.

#1027 (2014-09-11) Remember search settings for remembered search strings [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] This RFE relates to this one: 176 Memory for searched items 176 Although OmegaT now remembers previous searches, OmegaT does not remember the search options that accompanied that search e.g. whether only the TM should be searched for that term, of whether it is case sensitive, etc . This means that if a user previously searched for "ABC" case insensitive, and later searched for something case sens

#1024 (2014-09-02) Auto translate numbers / switch decimal and thousands separators [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] In most countries, the comma , is the decimal separator and the dot . is the thousands separator. It's the other way around in the US. It would be a really useful function if OmegaT could automatically "pre-translate" those numbers and put the comma and point in the right place -- at least if the segment only consists of a plain number so that it is clear that it's not an enumeration or something

#971 (2014-03-11) Improve search with "power search" features [Search & replace] This is a request to add the following to the Search functionality: to search entries that contain string1 but do not contain string2 to search entries that contain string1 in the source and string2 in the target to search entries that contain string1 in the source but do not contain -string2 in the target and viceversa This request is in line with: 850 849 818 Thanks, H.

#968 (2014-03-08) Add list of authors in Search interface [Search & replace] [Team projects & repositories] [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] The authors referenced in the TMX should be available with a drop down menu in the Search for Author interface. That allows a user to see how participates to a project team or not and to directly filter on that person.

#942 (2014-01-03) Easy find and insert subsegment [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Common issue for me when translating: Part of the segment has already been translated, for instance an URL. Current approach: - Select part of the segment. - Copy. - Ctrl+F. - Paste - Carefully select hit from tmx. - Copy. - Click on OmegaT main window - Paste. Suggested additional possible approach: - Select part of the segment. - Ctrl+space. - Ctrl+PgDwn few times till new function. - Replace. A

#882 (2013-08-15) update search window contents on segment changes [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] I have the following use case: In a wikipedia text I succeeded to use l for lower L instead of the vertical bar , which makes constructs pageName text misbehave - pageNameltext was definitely not my intention at the time of writing. The kind of errors can be located using a regex like ^ ? , resulting in a rather long list of segments, that need to be checked. Somewhere in the middle of the procedu

#879 (2013-06-17) Using Right Click in Text Search Result Window [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] When Text Search results are displayed right clicking on the window or text selected in it does not produce any action. To speed up the translation process, right clicking on selection in the Text Search result window could send text to the Editor window to insert it at current cursor position or replace a selection in the Editor window . A Possible Use Scenario: The user selects a word in the <b

#850 (2013-04-21) Have a Boolean search type of option in the Find dialog [Search & replace] It would be nice if OmegaT could also have a search mode that supports a type of Boolean syntax. This will make it possible to search inside OmegaT in a way that is very similar to the way one would search in e.g. Google or in many other search programs. It will also make it easier for users to exclude words from searches without having to resort to highly complex regular expressions.

#849 (2013-04-21) Add "whole words only" option to Find dialog [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] Currently, the only way to perform whole-word searches in OmegaT is using the wildcard search. However, the wildcard search is a more complex type of search, and it would be nice to be able to specify "whole words only" for the simple searches as well. I suggest that keyword searches and exact searches be given the option as a checkbox to perform "whole word" searches. The wildcards and ? should s

#824 (2013-02-18) "RegEx for fragments that should be removed" per project [Search & replace] [Spelling, tags & QA] Currently Regular expression for fragments that should be removed from translation lets you make a list that is being applied to every project. I love the feature, but I think it would make more sense if it worked on a project basis. I work with 3 language pairs, and that is 9 combinations, and even in two project with the same pairs sometimes call for two very different set of these RegEx'es. So,

#818 (2013-01-12) Improve the search on "Author" [Search & replace] [Team projects & repositories] [Editor & segmentation] With the team translation function implemented, it should be possible to search for authors different from self to identify segments that have been modified by other team members in a set period of time.

#796 (2012-07-23) Search of lacunas [Search & replace] Please, add a feature for search of lacunas in translation. In other words add feature for search of bad situations, when the sentence is not fully translated, or, for example, entered only one blank space. I think this may be a configurable option for search of suspicious discrepancies in the amount of text. Thanking you in anticipation for your help !

#702 (2011-08-03) Give message in Find dialog if no valid options II [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] This RFE is similar to 701 except that it can only give an error message after the search is done. Currently, if a user tries to do a search with options selected that are not valid for any of the searched documents, he will get no results, even if the term he searched for is in the searched files. The user does not know whether the search is empty because a the search term is not present or becau

#701 (2011-08-03) Give message in Find dialog if no valid options I [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [Statistics & counting] Currently, if a user tries to do a search but had deselected or not selected any options that would produce a result, the result is simply empty, and the user gets no indication that he might have done something wrong. For example, if "Search TMs" is selected but both "In source" and "In translations" are unticked, there will never be any results, so if the user tries to do a search with those opt

#674 (2011-01-23) Search specific segment numbers in Find dialog [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] I propose that users should be able to limit their searches in the Find dialog to specific segment numbers. This would, among others, allow users to limit searches to specific files one or more , but also to sections of files in the case of large files . I envisage the feature as a single-line text field in the "Advanced" tab of the Find dialog, in which users can separate multiple segment numbers

#667 (2011-01-11) Constrain Search to Document being edited [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] Simply put, there are many times when I'd prefer to know that all finds are in the document being translated - sometimes I go to the maching segment to see its context and then must find my way back to the segment in the document I was translating

#652 (2010-11-29) Search settings memory: change after/before [Search & replace] Currently, only the search settings "change after/before" are not remembered. It would be nice if they could be treated as all the other fields.

#650 (2010-11-15) Autocorrect (aka text replacement or auto-replace) [Search & replace] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] I propose that OmegaT get an autocorrect feature. Autocorrection is a bit of a misnomer because it doesn't only concern "correction", though it is commonly used for that. An autocorrect feature can correct common misspellings e.g. user types "taht" and OmT changes it to "that" automatically but can also reduce typing of repetitive phrases e.g. user types "wrt" and OmT changes it to "with regard to

#641 (2010-10-05) Do not stop file search when there is an invalid file [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] When a file search is performed, it stops at the first invalid file e.g., corrupted XML it cannot open. It would be more useful if the error was simply logged and the search would continue. Didier

#638 (2010-10-02) Search window: add "find" to the "found" window [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] A Ctrl+F in the field of found segments would be handy - just one additional, context-bound event handler. Use case: i I have a list of segments with "folder" in source ii would like to find all those segments that contain target equivalent of "directory" Ctrl+F "Directory

#543 (2009-06-19) selectable error messages [Search & replace] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Documentation & localisation] If the error messages were selectable it would be easier to make use of them. For ex: the "out of memory" error offers the command line parameters, but since it is not selectable, on has to check in the manual to find the correct syntax. If the text were selectable, it would only be a matter of pasting the code to the command line and restart.

#519 (2009-02-25) Search multiple file locations [Search & replace] [Project handling & files] At present, users of OmT can select a single folder with reference materials to search. If the user wants to search a different folder or set of folders, he has to click "Browse", navigate to the new folder, and select it. This can get annoying if the user has two or more different types of files that he prefers to search independently. What I propose, is this: have five fields for file location i

#518 (2009-02-25) Search different locations using shortcut [Search & replace] [Translation memory & matches] [UI, windows & usability] I noticed that one can select a term and then press Ctrl+F to search for it, but you still need to press ENTER to start the search. This is a good thing, IMO, because it allows the user the customise the search if he wants to. For example, he can select a different location or he can elect to search only the TM or only the files. However, the only way he can select a different location is using hi

#517 (2009-02-24) Stop button on Find window [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] When doing a search on files, the user may find a perfect answer within the first couple of results, but OmT will keep searching and searching and searching until all files have been searched. Suggestion: have a "Stop" button on the Search window that will cause OmT to stop searching. The Search window will remain open and all results that have appeared up to that stage should still be visible. --

#511 (2009-02-17) Able to use different font for search results [Search & replace] [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [UI, windows & usability] I use a large font for the Edit pane because this is a pane that I stare at for long periods of time. But I would prefer to see a lot of search results, to reduce scrolling. Since I don't stare at the search results all the time, it would be okay of the search results used a smaller font. I guess the same would apply to the Fuzzy Match pane and the Glossary pane. Also, the font of the Edit pane sh

#508 (2009-02-17) Use fewer dashes in the Search results [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, there are too many dashes in the Search results. It looks cluttered and is difficult to view. Currently, a search result may look like this: --------- -- 112> EDUCATION --------- -- 116> <f0>Further Education and Training College Sector</f0><f1> Recapitalisation</f1> --------- -- 117> HIV/Aids Life Skills Education --------- I suggest removing the two da

#506 (2009-02-17) Sticky Search windows [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] It would be nice if a user can select that a Search window remain the "front" window even though he is working in the Edit pane in OmegaT. In other programs, this is called "Always on top" or "Always at front". There could be a little thumb-tack icon/button on the Search window which, if ticked, puts the window always in front. This doesn't mean that it is always the active window -- when a user c

#504 (2009-02-17) Enable searches in the Search window [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] Wish: be able to search for words within the Search window. Currently, if the Search window is the active window, pressing Ctrl+F does nothing. I suggest that Ctrl+F brings up a secondary, simple search dialog with which a user can do a search on the Search results. The secondary search dialog should have buttons "Find next" and "Highlight all". Find Next simply highlights the next item. Highlight

#500 (2009-01-21) Insert/overwrite with search results [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Being able to directly use the search results in the editor window with a shortcut would be a great improvement. It must be somewhere here already... The shortcuts in the Editor window are not available when the search window is in the front. How about making them specific to the search window in that case ? For ex, to select a search item, use Ctrl+J, type the segment number. From there, use Shif
