#479 (2008-10-15) Search window shouldn't be displayed on top of main window [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] The text search window is by default brought up on top of the main window. For a new user, this is quite confusing, since it gives the impression that it's not possible to look at the text search window next to the main window, much less to click on a phrase in the text search window and be brought to the corresponding phrase in the main window. One the text search window is moved, it no longer ap

#477 (2008-10-10) New logo for OmegaT [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Hi, I do computer graphics I like your software and would like to contribute. Though I am not strong with icons, here comes a new logo proposal you will find omegat.svg there : I'd also like to contribute segmentation rules for Polish language, once I practice and collect them. Regards, Karol

#445 (2008-04-20) Allow to edit the project location while the project is used [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] When the project root directory has been modified externally, for ex, by changing the name of a directory in the registered path from the OS file manager, OmegaT refuses to save or to reload the data since it does not find the project data anymore. It would be more consistent with the rest of the properties interface and less troubling for non savvy users to let the user the possibility to indicat
#405 (2007-12-11) Search scope limitation [Search & replace] It would be nice to have the possibility to limit the scope of a search to the current file.

#351 (2007-07-27) Text parsing defined by regexp [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] Hello, I am encountering a problem with OmegaT regarding parsing files. I have several hundred files to translate with repeating strings looking like this: ---- {001 } {text to be translated } some comments {002 } {other text to be translated } some comments {015 } {other other text to be translated } ---- It's a tedious work to rewrite the parentheses and not delete the comments + similar strings

#337 (2007-05-15) modkey+F inside the search window [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] It is sometimes necessary to do a search from contents selected in the search window result list. It would be nice is a modkey+F shortcut could instanciate a new search with the selected part in the search field. If no strings are selected, modkey+F would put the focus on the existing window search field with its contents selected for eventual deletion.

#288 (2006-11-30) search window's focus [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Even when a segment is clicked upon, the search window does not go in the background which forces to use the mouse or other devices to put the edit window on the fg to be able to edit the selected segment. Annoying especially at the proofreading phase of the project when searches are quite numerous...

#263 (2006-11-23) File selection in Search [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] currently the search window displays only segment numbers. I think we should have the following option: select searched files that displays a lit of all the files in the project source possibly ordered by: -file name -file path -file category etc with a check box in front of them to include them or exclude them from the search the window should display the results by file with the file name indica

#257 (2006-11-19) copy source/target section of a pair displayed in search [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] currently the search window is useful for reference but using it requires a lot of mousing. when the search window is in the foreground, modkey+arrow allows to highlight the results and modkey+s copies the source part, modkey+t copies the target part of the highlighted result. once the search is dismissed or in the bg, the copied contents can be pasted into the target filed of the current segment.

#233 (2006-10-31) Search in source and target separately [Search & replace] from an older exchange between Henry and JC: JC: ------------------------------- it is easy to have 2 search field of flags for the current search field to do: source=something and/or etc other logical operators target=somethingelse ------------------------------- Henry: ------------------------------- I'm not sure, but I think it's not hard to implement. However, where in the box are we going to
Glossaries & terminology — 52 tickets, 12 upvotes, 201 comments
g.text: Glossaries & terminology (52)

g.title: #1794 (2025-12-23) Allow glossary entries to include wildcard/regex patterns [Glossaries & terminology] [Search & replace] Feature Request: Pattern-Based Glossary Entries with Variable Substitution Use Case Technical translation especially patents frequently involves terms followed by reference codes that vary across documents. Currently, translators must create separate glossary entries for every combination of term + code. Example: 音出力部1000 → sound output unit 1000 音出力部1001 → sound output unit 1001 音出力部200a → sound

#1750 (2024-06-11) Throw an error when creating a project with the same language as source and target [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] I created a project to to translate a literary text from an old version of a language to its contemporary version. As this is the same language Neapolitan , I used the same language code nap in the Source and Target fields when creating the project. This did not throw any warnings and I translated the first chapter over the following days, without ever closing OmegaT. However, when I closed it and

#1730 (2023-12-11) Glossary pane contextual menu [Glossaries & terminology] [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] The glossary pane contextual menu should have the following items: - access glossary folder - open writable glossary - filter search on selected term

#1729 (2023-12-11) Take into account glossary fields after the 3rd one [Glossaries & terminology] As a first step to support multiple column fields in the glossary, we could concatenate all the fields after the second with clear field separators. For ex : Source term Target term Comment field fourth field fifth field sixth field etc.

#1728 (2023-12-11) Support various protocols in glossary comment [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] The glossary pane currently supports the http external protocol, but it would be practical to have other protocols, like file://, dict://, etc.

#1711 (2023-08-18) Regular expressions for glossary entries [Glossaries & terminology] [Search & replace] In patent documents, many recurring elements will have different reference codes. Currently, I would create a new entry for every element with a previously undefined reference symbol. It would be great if we could use regular expressions so that there needs to be only one entry per element. E.g., Currently every time I see something like モータ５, I would create an entry for Source term: モータ５ Target t

#1705 (2023-06-20) Copy text from source and text from target and automatically add them both in appropriate text box when adding a glossary entry [Glossaries & terminology] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Do you think it could be possible to implement the following? 1. We select a word or an expression in source segment 2. We have text in target and we select the equivalent of the above in de target language 3. When pressing "Create glossary entry" both the menu button or the shortcut and the Create glossary entry dialog pops-up, both source and target selected text are in place in their correspond

#1599 (2021-11-09) Support TBX v3 [Glossaries & terminology] [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Project handling & files] [Documentation & localisation] [Installation & platform] Linux, using java-11-openjdk-amd64 and running OmegaT 5.6.0. Loading new tbx files downloaded from the IATE website fails with the following error in the console: When opening the tbx file in a text editor with that error message in mind, I did find the <tbx tag. I have old tbx files from the IATE website that do not contain that tag, these files worked perfectly. I also tried the csv file which w

#1573 (2021-06-05) Improve glossary parser to handle line breaks within a field [Glossaries & terminology] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] The current implementation does not allow for line breaks within a field. Reference:

#1566 (2021-05-09) Replace glossary hits when inserting fuzzy match [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [Installation & platform] Preconditions New segment to translate: Code of Behaviour Existing match in the auto TM: Code of Conduct -- Código de conducta Existing entries in the glossary: - behaviour -- comportamiento - conduct -- conducta Steps to reproduce 1. Go to segment 2. Select fuzzy match 3. Press Ctrl+I or Ctrl+R to insert it Expected results OmegaT detects that the part of the fuzzy match that is different from th

#1500 (2020-07-09) Allowing more fields in glossaries [Glossaries & terminology] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, a glossary file can contain up to 3 fields typically Term, Equivalent, Miscellaneous . However, some translators use more complex glossaries or termbases with many more fields, for exemple Equivalence Source, Definition, Definition Source, Context, Context Source, Subdomain... Being able to display all these informations within OmegaT without having to merge fields or otherwise tinkerin

#1493 (2020-05-20) Include source terms in right-click glossary match list [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] When the cursor is hovering over an underlined term in the editor, the source term appears followed by matching glossary entries. A right-click on the source term brings up a list of matching glossary entries that can be selected for insertion. However the corresponding source terms are not shown. It would be useful to have the option of including the source terms in the right-click list that appe

#1483 (2020-02-10) Create dummy files in tm/glossary/dictionary folders [Glossaries & terminology] [Team projects & repositories] [Dictionaries] [Translation memory & matches] [Project handling & files] [Documentation & localisation] Hello. I have small feature request. I have one of my OmegaT projects on github. Each time I have to type "git clone" command on a new device, I am forced to manually create folders "tm", "dictionary" and "glossary" inside project folder, because these folders are empty and they are not properly synchronized by GIT. Could you please add a function to place in that folders some dummy files that wou

#1478 (2019-12-15) Mark preferred term in glossary [Glossaries & terminology] [Editor & segmentation] The segment text already shows glossary hists by underlining the term. It would be helpful, if OmegaT could underline the most frequent use of a target term within a project in a list of alternative meanings of a source term. Example: Assume the source term x has the target terms a, b, and c listed in the glossary. Out of these meanings the term b is used most often in a running project. Therefore

#1457 (2019-07-15) Glossary Tiptool when caret on underlined word [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Right now OmegaT has a very useful tooltip that automatically shows the glossary matches when hovering with the cursor id est, mouse over any underlined word. Given that in recent versions of OmegaT it is possible to navigate freely with the keyboard in the source text, it would be fantastic if this glossary tooptip could appear automatically also when the caret not the cursor is on any underlined

#1411 (2018-12-02) Detect already existing terms in the glossary folder [Glossaries & terminology] [Project handling & files] Hi there, I am wondering why OmegaT could not detect or alert users about already existing terms in the glossary file. It happens when I tried to add the same source and target term, or simply another translation for the same term. Is it possible to add such function to it? Otherwise, it is kind of troublesome to maintain a neat and consistent glossary. I truly appreciate your kind assistance!

#1377 (2018-03-04) Terminology validation does not properly identify Katakana words [Glossaries & terminology] [Spelling, tags & QA] Even if properly translated, terminology validation does not properly identify Katakana words when they are written sequencially and generates issues.

#1376 (2018-03-04) False positives in terminology checking [Glossaries & terminology] [Spelling, tags & QA] If a string is registered with multiple translations and one is used, the terminology validation still creates an issue and fails to recognize the applied glossary item pair. For ex: enter = Enter キー Enter = 入力 if an " enter " string is present in source and target is properly translated as "Enter キー", a terminology issue will still be created based on "Enter = 入力". There should not be an issue he

#1375 (2018-03-04) Add "validate terminology when leaving a segment" [Glossaries & terminology] [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] It would be useful to have alerts when leaving a segment where there are terminology issues.

#1322 (2017-06-27) Adjust spaces when performing glossary replacement [Glossaries & terminology] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Installation & platform] Since last update, "Replace glossary hits when inserting source text" is not working properly when the source or target glossary has a preceding or trailing space. Sometimes leaving a space in the glossary terms helps removing the unneeded words automatically when moves to the next segment.

#1292 (2016-12-13) Make glossary function ignore tags [Glossaries & terminology] [Spelling, tags & QA] [UI, windows & usability] The glossary function does not recognize entries if the source term is broken by a tag. It would be nice if the glossary function ignored tags at least for the purpose of displaying glossary entries in the glossary window.

#1285 (2016-10-31) Make tab separated glossaries reversible [Glossaries & terminology] [Dictionaries] Currently, the default tab separated glossaries are not reversible. It would do good to add a first line as a header, to tell the languages of the columns, such as: where escape string is anything uncommon enough not cause many problems with existing dictionaries and tab is a tab character. This would allow easier reuse of glossaries and remove the need of using spreadsheet programs to change the

#1279 (2016-10-25) On/off setting for the glossary tooltip [Glossaries & terminology] [Dictionaries] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] The new popup that appears showing the glossary terms on hover sometimes covers all the screen. Unless I move the mouse away from the editor, it hides everything. There should be a way to avoid that: either the ability to turn off the popup or the possibility to increase the delay before the popup is displayed. Otherwise maybe remove it and if the glossary tab is not comfortable enough as it was m

#1277 (2016-10-25) Thesaurus Feature [Glossaries & terminology] [Dictionaries] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be nice to have thesaurus for the target language as another item/option of the autocomplete function activated by Ctrl+Space . Dictionary of synonyms is extremely useful when one is searching for the best translation of a source term. The use scenario would be to press the shortcut Ctrl+Space , to go over to the 'Thesaurus' option by "Ctrl+Shift+Spece", to select the right synonym by arr

#1251 (2016-06-13) Display glossary file name in the Glossary pane [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] This will help distinguish between glossary entries from different glossary files in a project. The current workaround for me is to add file names as comments third column in txt files. The suggested option could be a better way to do this.

#1237 (2016-04-22) Ignore-list for glossaries [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] [Documentation & localisation] It often happens that a glossary may contain words that the user might not want to see in the Glossary pane, but it's too much trouble to maintain two separate glossaries one for OmegaT, and one for use elsewhere . An example may be that a client sends a glossary along with every job, but the glossary typically contains terms that a you know how to translate and/or b you disagree with. It is too m

#1209 (2016-03-30) Glossary not picking up term with leading or trailing _ (underscore) [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] Sometimes the terms are connected with underscore in the original sentence, which makes the glossary fail to pick up the term even if it is in the glossary. Example: If I have the following term in my glossary. English: Status Japanese: ステータス if the original sentence is The Policy Status is open, an error is thrown. The glossary pane will not display the term "Status".

#1184 (2016-02-25) Adding headers to glossary txt format [Glossaries & terminology] [File filters & formats] I was using another CAT tool lately and I noticed that it uses simple CSV files for glossaries, pretty much like OmegaT's. However, its format requires an header with the languages. This is very useful when maintaining glossaries, because you can use the same glossary for both directions, which is currently not possible in OmegaT only if you use TBX . This could also be useful for having multiling

#1149 (2015-11-01) Numbers on glossary entries [Glossaries & terminology] [Editor & segmentation] I think it could be very useful if we could type a number that appears next to a glossary entrie, avoiding navigating with cursors.
#1130 (2015-09-24) SHIFT+F3 in Create Glossary Entry dialog [Glossaries & terminology] Allow to change case of text with SHIFT+F3 in Create GlossaryEentry dialog.

#1108 (2015-07-02) Edit glossary entry in OmegaT [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] It would be great to be able to edit glossary entries using a dialog similar to "Create glossary entry". A right click menu item on a glossary entry in the glossary pane or in the source text field seems to be a logical place for calling such function. If the entry comes from a non-default glossary, a new edited entry should be added to the project's writable glossary instead of the one where it o

#1100 (2015-06-12) Implement Microsoft Terminology Service API [Glossaries & terminology] [Machine translation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] We already have Microsoft Translator API implemented. Why not adding Microsoft Terminology Service API?

#1088 (2015-05-08) Show glossary file name in search results window [Glossaries & terminology] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] This is a request to make search results from Glossaries to show the file name of the file containing the result, in the same manner as results from memory and TMs.

#1003 (2014-06-13) Add the ability to select a glossary to add a glossary term to [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] For example, through a dropdown menu in the add glossary term window. This will extend the functionality of the Main glossary feature highlighted in the Glossary pane by allowing users to choose a glossary where the new term belongs to instead of writing everything into the default one.

#988 (2014-04-18) Automatic capitalizing glossary terms at beginning of a segment [Glossaries & terminology] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] [Documentation & localisation] I suggest the following feature: when entering a word/phrase from the glossary via transtips i.e. right clicking an underlined word - I believe that right-clicking on the word from the glossary pane is another way , and if the word/phrase is the first word in the current segment, then that word should be automatically capitalized. In the case of a phrase then only the first word should be capitali

#941 (2014-01-01) Replace line breaks with spaces in comment field of glossary item creation dialog [Glossaries & terminology] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] After entering a multiline comment in the comment field, the glossary item pane only shows the first line.

#932 (2013-12-06) To add a function of selecting the glossary upon adding a word [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] Problem: Due to the fact that now OmegaT supports several glossaries there often appears a need to put one word into one glossary e.g. main and another word to another glossary e.g. specific software UI glossary . Suggestion: It would be rather convenient if the OmegaT user upon adding the word was able to select a glossary where to add the word to. As an addition there could be a possibility to a

#931 (2013-12-03) Allow glossary auto-completion to match source text, not target text [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Problem: If a user wants to use auto-completion to insert the translation of a term that he knows is in the glossary, he has to either use Ctrl+Space itself which will give a list of all glossary terms in the segment or he has to glance at the Glossary pane, find the translation of the term, and then start typing the translation, before pressing Ctrl+Space. The fact that the user has to look at th

#893 (2013-09-28) Format glossary window, making terms bold. [Glossaries & terminology] [Dictionaries] [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] The glossary contains a lot of matches with lots of text due to the way we work and generate it. It is quite hard to pick at a glance the glossary words. Suggested change: see picture : Make the glossary term bold, just like in a dictionary. For instance in the picture, make "Names" bold.

#789 (2012-06-04) Tematres integration [Glossaries & terminology] [Documentation & localisation] The integration of Tematres would bring the glossary functionality of OmegaT to whole new level. Tematres is an open source vocabulary server you can use to design terminologies, taxonomies, glossaries, vocabularies and whatever you want to call it. It offers webservices which should make the integration quite feasible. Via the integration users would have a great tool to manage their glossaries u

#738 (2011-12-09) Use wildcards or regexp in Glossary [Glossaries & terminology] [Search & replace] Translators from different languages, especially those, which don't have tokenizers are in the urgent need to use at least wildcards such as " " in Glossary. Many languages have endings in their words. For example, in Russian, Ukrainian, Belorussian,... For example in them there is a nominative case of the last name "Ivanov". In different cases it will be "Ivanova", "Ivanovu", "Ivanovym", etc.. Al

#698 (2011-07-29) Wrong focus on glossary window [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] When you invoke the 'Create glossary entry' window, regardless of the text you selected before hitting CTRL+SHIFT+G, the focus is not in the first input field, so 1 additional tab is needed to be able to write in the 'Source target' text box. Not sure if this qualifies as a bug or feature request. Of course, feel free to move it where it belongs. Kind regards Marco

#685 (2011-04-07) Special OmT glossary format with pseudostemming [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Problem: Tokenizers are only available in a few languages, and they are not customizable. Solution: Let OmegaT have a special glossary format that allows matching of multiple forms of the word. This glossary would be a UTF8 plaintext file with the file extension ".omt4". The "4" indicates that it has a fourth column with multiple forms of the word. For example, the four columns in the glossary fil

#469 (2008-09-18) Make apostrophe a word boundary in glossary tool [Glossaries & terminology] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] If I have a glossary containing for example the word "ananas", OmegaT does not display it in the glossary window when a segment contains "l'ananas". It would be excellent if OmegaT recognized the apostrophe as a word boundary for recognition of glossary terms. Thanks very much.

#376 (2007-10-07) Display "no glossary" if no glossary [Glossaries & terminology] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] When OmegaT detects that there are no valid glossries in the /glossary/ folder, it displays the following message in the Glossary pane: "You don't seem to have any valid glossaries in your /glossary/ folder. Using glossaries is optional, but remember, OmegaT does not create them automatically."

#369 (2007-09-30) Repair fuzzy matches with glossary items [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] OmegaT could propose translations based on a combination of the best match and the glossary items that do not fit. Ex: translated: I like cakes -> j'aime les gateaux glossary: bananas -> les bananes new segment: I like bananas match: 66% -> I like cakes pseudo match: I like s/cakes/bananas -> j'aime s/les gateaux/les bananes = j'aime les bananes. Articles, conjugations etc are tricky b

#359 (2007-08-16) Convert tool for tab-delimited memories [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] Following some more questions about similar things in the OmegaT user's forum, here's my RFE for importing tab-delimited glossaries. Many users are able to create a table in OpenOffice or similar that contains source and target in the two columns, but converting that to TMX is a lot more tricky. Also some people may have their memories in a tab delimited format Wordfast . It would be great if Omeg

#340 (2007-06-14) Manage project glossary [Glossaries & terminology] [Search & replace] [Documentation & localisation] It would be nice to have more advanced glossary management functions within OmegaT. Add Remove Edit for a start. Thank you Stefan PS. I cannot find roadmap on the website. Is there a list of planned features?

#268 (2006-11-27) create glossaries from bundles [Glossaries & terminology] [Alignment] [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Documentation & localisation] [Installation & platform] A Java bundle is mostly used for GUI work. The same GUI items will have to be used in the documentation. For that it would be useful to be also able to export the aligned bundle to the OmegaT glossary format as well as to TMX.

#190 (2006-06-05) Four suggestions for Glossaries [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [UI, windows & usability] I have decided to post these four as a single RFE because they rely on each other. == 1 . Display of comments I think the glossary pane should display only the source term and the target term. However, every term should have a number, and by using Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2 etc, the translator can "compare" or "check" a specific term, and when he does, and if there is a comment in the third column of the glos

#126 (2005-12-06) Tool: Pseudo translate [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] A pseudo-translate function was available until 1.4.2. It produced a project tmx including all the target equal to source regardless of the matches. Now that we have target options, it would be nice to similarly have: A pseudo translate function with: -fill with match when match above nn % yes/no+ % parameter + pseudo string at the head of the target segment -fill with source and replace with glos

#90 (2005-09-21) 2.0+ project analysis [Glossaries & terminology] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] At project opening, OmegaT analyses the segments and produces a list of strings that frequently appear in the whole project. Such strings would be long enough that a segment would be composed of no more than 1~5 of them. They could be proposed as a list in the source files for the creation of a mini TM that would be used later during the translation project. The mini TM would be handled in a way s
Spelling, tags & QA — 50 tickets, 13 upvotes, 143 comments
g.text: Spelling, tags & QA (50)

g.title: #1772 (2025-01-16) Mark issues as resolved [Spelling, tags & QA] When I check for issues, I would like to have a way to mark issues as resolved or ignore them. Some issues are in fact not an issue and needs to be exactly as they are. OmegaT considers them an issue. If I could tell the software that I've considered them and make them disappear from the list, it would declutter the issues list a lot.
#1738 (2024-02-25) Ignoring issues options [Spelling, tags & QA] We could ignore issues based on options like "ignore issues when source=text".

#1737 (2024-02-01) Make spellchecker work in OpenBSD amd64 [Spelling, tags & QA] [Installation & platform] Hi All, Could you please attempt to make any spellchecker work in OpenBSD amd64. Steps to reproduce: In an OpenBSD installation, use OmegaT cross platform without JRE version, try to download and enable spellchecker in Preferences for target language. Java version used - from OpenBSD package: openjdk 17.0.8 2023-07-18 OpenJDK Runtime Environment build 17.0.8+7-1 OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM build 17.0

#1724 (2023-10-31) Block creation of target files only if the SELECTED issues are found [Spelling, tags & QA] [Project handling & files] Background and current behaviour Currently the feature "Block the creation of target files with tag issues" in Options Preferences Tag Processing makes no distinction by type of issue. If any tag issues are found, target files are not created. However, not all tag issues are equal. It may be interesting to prevent creation of the target files if, say, missing tags or extraneous tags are found, but

#1677 (2023-02-13) Refactoring the confusing `removeTags` properties [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] We currently have two identically named properties for different features, which is a bit confusing when trying to understand what the code is doing: - The Project "Remove tags" PP REMOVE TAGS handled by org.omegat.core.data.ProjectProperties.removeTags , which remove all the tags in all the segments. - The Filter "Remove leading and trailing tags" FILTERSCUSTOMIZER OPTION GLOBAL REMOVE TAGS handl

#1674 (2023-02-10) Remove custom tags issues and flagged text from mandatory tag check [Spelling, tags & QA] Rationale The "Tags issues" option is checked by default and is mandatory it can't be unchecked . That option checks several kinds of issues: - standard tags issues - custom tags issues - flagged text issues Often some missing custom tags are not a problem, and also flagged text is sometimes okay. In some projects there can be a large number of custom tags/flagged text non-issues or false positive

#1673 (2023-02-08) HTML: tags should display the actual tag on mouse hover [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] The tooltip displayed for tags on mouse hover currently shows the tag which does not really provide any extra value. It would be nice if these could display the actual tag. They could even display some info on the tag eg how it affects the text before/after it .

#1672 (2023-02-07) Hide tag-only segments [Spelling, tags & QA] [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Current behaviour Segments containing only tags are displayed just like any other segment. For example, consider the following five segments: 1. foo 2. <x1 3. bar 4. <g1 </g1 5. qux Requested feature New option: ☑️ Hide tag-only segments If that option is checked, then segments that contain only tags are hidden. For example, the text above would be: 1. foo 2. bar 4. qux To be precise, segments wou

#1669 (2023-01-26) Remove leadinga and trailing tags with Okapi filters [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] Scope This RFE probably only applies to OmegaT projects using Okapi filters only tested with Okapi XML filter . Background and current behaviour Consider the following XML source content, where the <text element is extracted as a translatable text unit: When extracted using the Okapi OpenXML filter In OmegaT and segmentation is deactivated, we get one segment: 1. <g1 <g2 Include both full-time and

#1660 (2022-12-23) Provide better access to results of CI/CD tools [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] I might have missed it but as far as I know, there's no way to see much of what is happening on the Azure pipelines? I think it would be nice to provide some visibility on the pipelines themselves and also on their results. I have given SonarCloud a go and it's quite nice. I think this sort of tools would be especially useful for more junior developers and can help get them started as they provide

#1645 (2022-10-30) Custom tag field width [Spelling, tags & QA] [UI, windows & usability] The custom tag field width seems to extend until the Preferences window occupies most of the screen width. It would be nice to have the field wrap at a certain width and expend in height instead.

#1644 (2022-10-27) Keyboard access to languageTool tips [Spelling, tags & QA] [UI, windows & usability] LanguageTool tips require mouse access for display and it would be more practical to have them displayed in the context menu, like the spellchecking suggestions.

#1559 (2021-03-24) Validate tags when leaving a segment only for that segment [Spelling, tags & QA] [Team projects & repositories] [Editor & segmentation] Background OmegaT has a very useful function to run QA checks, of which tags are not optional. This checks both standard and custom tags. Preconditions Have an OmegaT project with tag issues e.g. missing tags in several translated segments. Steps to reproduce 1. Enable option in Preferences Editor Validate tags when leaving a segment . 2. Go to one segment with tag issues and press Enter to commit

#1526 (2020-11-24) Enable ignore function when checking issues [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] The translations of some segments break certain rules on purpose. A title, for instance, usually doesn't have ending punctuation. The "check issues" Ctrl + Shift + V service of OmegaT marks this as an issue, while in reality, it isn't an issue. In large documents, it can get difficult to remember which issues are actually not issues. This decreases the efficiency of "check issues". I propose addin

#1476 (2019-12-15) Test Vector List for QA ("Check issues...") [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] I am currently doing a big project on OmegaT containing 280 files to be translated and find myself running a list of test vectors I plan to run at QA stage. Hence, it would be very handy if OmegaT would allow to store such a list of test vectors that is, search strings which the system automatically uses during 'Check Issues...' as an additional checking category, meaning the system would just sea

#1445 (2019-04-29) Multiple-value input/editor for custom tags [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] I use the custom tags in many of my projects. They are specially useful to deal with some of the XLIFF files I receive from the client, who doesn't treat HTML markup as inline codes but simply escapes it and it appears as text,e.g. <b> . Custom tags allow me to protect this markup and insert it more easily in the translation. But I also use them for any other untranslatable that must be repl

#1443 (2019-04-21) Improve "Check Issues" useability [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] There are 2 usability issues with the "Check Issues" interface: 1 it is not possible to uncheck "Tag Issues". 2 even though there is a refresh button, the table is automatically refreshed after validating a change in a segment For translation reviews the number of issues can be significant and the automatic refresh can lead to considerable loss of time. In the current project I have 1200 language

#1427 (2019-03-16) Project-specific custom tag definition [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] [Project handling & files] Having one user-wide definition for all projects becomes a bit inconvenient when different projects have different requirements for untranslatables including custom tags . Regular expressions for custom tag definition could be more accurate and easier to maintain if they were project-specific, like a file stored in a file in the /omegat folder as for other project-specific settings or in the proje

#1374 (2018-03-04) The [Tag} check box can't be unchecked in the issue options [Spelling, tags & QA] [Glossaries & terminology] [UI, windows & usability] Even when selecting a different issue category for ex working on Terminology the fact that Tags are checked restores the Tag+other issues layout at every refresh. It would be nice to have the ability to uncheck tags, just like any other issue category.

#1373 (2018-03-04) Register issue window layout [Spelling, tags & QA] [UI, windows & usability] The issue window layout keeps reverting to default every time the issues are refreshed. It would be nice to have the layout be remembered from a session to the next.

#1365 (2017-12-28) Remember sorting, tab, and issue after refreshing for Issues tabs other than All [Spelling, tags & QA] [Glossaries & terminology] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] Suppose, running Issues with terminology check resulst in three tabs: All, Spelling, Terminology. I work with the Terminology tab and sort it by the Description column, i.e., alphabetically by term. As soon as a I hit the Refresh button or b I edit a segment, the Issues refresh and I am thrown back to the All tab and a different issue. However, it would be much more practical to continue working w

#1349 (2017-11-01) Check issues for current folder [Spelling, tags & QA] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] Suppose, an OmegaT project includes 100 files. I need to complete the first batch 50 files by the end of the first month, and the second batch by the end of the second month. When finalizing the second batch, I don't want OmegaT to display the issues from the first batch, because I already checked them. Running Check issues for current document for each document is also impractical. One option wou

#1317 (2017-05-10) Optionally disable issues list updating [Spelling, tags & QA] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] In a relatively big project, the issues list update can take a few seconds to complete. When shifting from the OmegaT interface to the Issues window, the Issues are automatically updated which forces the user to wait a few seconds before checking the remaining issues on the list.

#1302 (2017-01-04) Shortcut for inserting "tag pairs" [Spelling, tags & QA] [Glossaries & terminology] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] It would be nice that users had the possibility to add a shortcut to make use of the "Insert Next Missing Tag Pair" functionality 947 . Reasoning: Now that we have History Predictions, History Completions, Autotext entries, Glossary entries, Missing tags, and Character table all in the same Autocompleter view, inserting a missing "tag pair" requires between five and six iterations of Ctrl+Space an

#1114 (2015-08-23) Deleting all the Text (but not Tags) in a Segment [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Problem: Sometimes there are too many garbage tags in a segment, so it is better to remove all the source text and write the translation before or after agglomerated tags. Solution: It would probably be useful to be able to delete all the source text by one command one macro, one shortcut .

#1106 (2015-06-26) Override tag validation for specific segments [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] Currently, there are two options related to overriding of tag validation: "Allow translated tags to be in a different order" and "Do not allow creating translated documents with tag issues", which can be unchecked. Both are global options. This is a request to allow overriding of tag validation issues segment-specific. Thus, in a project where specific tag issues are identified by the user as non-

#1096 (2015-06-09) LaTeX filter: translate inline comments as tags [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] Requested by Marco Cevoli: In LaTeX, comments can be embedded inside the translatable text. Example: This is a text % First comment with inline % Second comment comments. Currently, the LaTeX filter does no special processing for inline comments. They should be processed as tags and, depending on a user option, either not displayed at all, or displayed as sub-segments, as is done by the HTML filte

#1015 (2014-07-28) Display warning when spell check not working [Spelling, tags & QA] [Dictionaries] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] I happened to me quite a few times that I carried out a translation and afterwards wondered about my spelling mistakes found in Microsoft Word. The reason was that the target language in the project settings was set to 'de' or 'en' instead of 'de-de' or 'en-us'. As a consequence the spell check did not work although I had the dictionaries installed. Especially when you don't actively pay attention

#1013 (2014-07-18) Spellchecking/grammar checking access through the Auto-completion feature [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] When a spellchecking mistake occurs, it would be much faster to hit the Auto-completion key and see the suggestions automatically. It would be even greater if OmegaT recognised the context and instead of forcing the user to change of auto-completion mode, automatically shifts to the spell-checking mode when required.

#990 (2014-04-28) Ignore tags in searches [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] This is a request to add three radio buttons to Search: Ignore OmegaT tags Ignore Custom tags Ignore All tags and a check box to activate/deactivate the tag-ignoring feature. Such a functionality would enable searching all instances of a string, independently of the amount/position of intermingled tags in the text. See:

#977 (2014-03-26) Word filter: reduce number of unnecessary tags [Spelling, tags & QA] [Team projects & repositories] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] The Word filter shows lots of tags during translation. Especially with "old" documents with many revisions. In the past, I've assisted a team that worked on a Word add-on that allows to fill Word documents through SQL using Word templates. During the development I've seen many XML fragments coming by which had no visual representation. At this moment we are working on loading filled Word forms bac

#973 (2014-03-16) Make tooltip for SDLXLIFF ph tags more meaningful [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] Make tooltip for SDLXLIFF < ph tags more meaningful Sometimes, < ph tags are placeholders. Example: SDLXLIFF: The < x id="2512" xid="3f5c4f7c-5e43-49ad-a61a-58142c356bde" / is intended for use in the electromagnetic environment specified below. OmegaT: The < x0/ is intended for use in the electromagnetic environment specified below. Tooltip: < x id="2512" xid="3f5c4f7c-5e43-49ad-a61a-58142c356bde"

#927 (2013-11-24) Option to add translatable tags to HTML Filter 2. [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [Documentation & localisation] Many file formats have a strong resemblance with HTML, but add some extra processing tags. For instance ascx or Invantive Server Pages. They may contain translatable elements too and are sometimes fit for automatic translation. We have a DotNetNuke website with forms in ascx and I would like them translated. However, the input fields are formatted in the HTML as: <div class="dnnFormItem"> &l

#926 (2013-11-24) Make Regular expression for custom tags project-specific [Spelling, tags & QA] [Team projects & repositories] [Search & replace] [Documentation & localisation] 1. What is a custom tag in one project is not necessarily an untranslatable in another project. 2. This will allow sending a project to a team member with this option already configured instead of asking that team member to configure it manually. This request is similar to Kos's 824 "RegEx for fragments that should be removed" per project, which I also second.

#889 (2013-09-22) Removing Many Wrong Tags at Once [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] When a segment is opened in the Editor windows and there are many wrong tags in it, it would be useful to be able to remove them all in one step by selecting a right-click menu item or pressing a key combination. Removing wrong tags one by one by selecting and deleting them is difficult and time-consuming.

#848 (2013-04-20) Let Ctrl+C of Ctrl+X within a tag copy/cut the whole tag [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] Make it so that if the cursor is inside a tag i.e. after < or before , then Ctrl+X cuts the whole tag, and/or Ctrl+C copies the whole tag, so what when the user uses Ctrl+V, it pastes the whole tag. This will eliminate having to select the whole tag carefully before doing the cut or copy operation. The Ctrl+C operation should also work if the cursor is inside a tag in the source field obviously Ct

#814 (2012-12-20) Dynamic "Code" Highlighting [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [Documentation & localisation] I would like to suggest dynamic highlighting withing the current segment editing area. What I mean by that is a functionality found in many text editors and IDE's which helps you trace opening and closing brackets, quotes, manual linebreaks, tabs etc. It can be utilized to check for opening and closing tags too, among other things. Maybe there could be a separate config file where the highlighting

#766 (2012-03-12) Optional to highlight spaces next to tags [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] Problem: Spacing before and after tags is very important but is not always very visible to the translator. Inserting a space can create an unwanted space in the middle of a word in the target file, or removing a space can cause words in the target file to be concatenated and a spellcheck would not necessarily pick it up . For tags that relate to line breaks etc, a missing or extra space can cause

#761 (2012-03-04) Tag verification displays only unique segments [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] The Tag Verification window should only display one instance of each faulty segment. Or at least have the option to do so. Or to display non uniques with a different color same as the Editor setting?

#728 (2011-11-08) Create default segmentation rules taking tags into account [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] I have a document in DOCX format that contains a good deal of formatting codes. These codes lead to improper segmentation. Examples: "... some text here. <t1/>Some more text here ..." " ... sentence A here.<t1/> <t2/>Sentence B here ..." Currently, OmegaT just checks for period-followed-by-space and doesn't segment the above-mentioned examples. As a general rule, OmegaT should om

#721 (2011-10-17) Allow escaping equal-signs in INI [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] This is not urgent at all: I have idea how the INI or LNG formats usually escape equal-signs, but I see OmT has no standard way of doing it. OmT will interpret the first encountered equal-sign in the line as the key=value delimiter. But what if the key or the value contains an equal sign itself? I suggest that OmT adds its own way of dealing with this issue, by not regarding doubled equal-signs as

#686 (2011-05-17) XHTML: option to force closer tags instead of empty tags [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] Tags which have no content like "<a></a>" or "<br />" will be changed when the file is translated via OmegaT. the issue occurs only in XHTML file. for example: <a></a> will be changed to <a/> <div></div> will be changed to <div/> <br /> will be changed to <br/> Can check with the attached xhtml file? thx.

#636 (2010-09-29) Swing Default Look and Feel [Spelling, tags & QA] It would be great if OmegaT respected swing.defaultlaf set for the whole system or for individual users. I realize it wouldn't add any new functionality and thus is a minor issue. But the completely white background of the default Metal LAF puts a bit of strain on one's eyes when trying to work in the evening.

#635 (2010-09-26) Tag validation table display [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] [UI, windows & usability] The tag validation could use 2 features already existing in other parts of OmegaT: 1 an easy keyboard based navigation similar to the Project Files list 2 a filtering option to display at once all the non validated segments in the Editor window

#453 (2008-06-03) HTML converts " to " in PRE tags [Spelling, tags & QA] [File filters & formats] [Project handling & files] [Installation & platform] Using OmT 1.7.3 2 on WinXP Pro with Java 1.6.0 05-b13 . OmegaT converts &quote; to " even in the PRE text, which means that the translated file differs from the source file with regard to the PRE content.

#444 (2008-04-11) Spellcheck menu item [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] Create a menu item preferably under Edit to "Check spelling while typing" or something similar, with a dedicated shortcut, that is equivalent to checking the box "Automatically check the spelling of text" in the Spellcheck dialog. besides, the dialog box should be dismissable with esc for consistency with other similar dialogs . JC

#392 (2007-10-18) "Auto spellcheck" status option [Spelling, tags & QA] [Dictionaries] [Translation memory & matches] [Scripting, plugins & automation] [UI, windows & usability] [Installation & platform] - The "Automatically check the spelling of text" box should be out of the dialog and available from the top of the Options menu as a checkable item: a "Spellcheck" label should be enough. If none of the installed dictionaries match the target language and "Spellcheck" is triggered, a dialog should be displayed: "Install a dictionary that matches your target language or change the target language c

#230 (2006-10-31) shortening of tags series containing _no_ translatable parts [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] I have the following tag series in a segment: <f1><df2><di3/></df2></f1> which corresponds to the following code: <text:span text:style-name="T15"><draw:frame draw:style-name="fr1" draw:name="graphics1" text:anchor-type="as-char" svg:width="0.335cm" svg:height="0.335cm" draw:z- index="0"><draw:image xlink:href="Pictures/ 100000000000000E0000000EDBA8D174

#213 (2006-09-07) Indicate file names in tag validation window [Spelling, tags & QA] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] The tag validation window should indicate verified file names so as to go directly to the problematic section of the window when one specific file only is targeted. One way to do that would be to put the file name on a 2 column spanning row from where the file segments start to be displayed.

#168 (2006-03-09) Add "Validate" button to Validate Tags window [Spelling, tags & QA] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] Similar to the Search window, the Validate Tags window could have a "Validate" button, which upon pressed would refresh the window, just like the Search button does in the Search window. This saves from having to close and open the window again to refresh it.
UI, windows & usability — 33 tickets, 7 upvotes, 141 comments
g.text: UI, windows & usability (33)

g.title: #1796 (2026-02-25) Zero Width Space as special character [UI, windows & usability] It would be useful to have the zero width space in the character sheet accessible via Ctrl+Space

#1733 (2023-12-15) Import/export review files [UI, windows & usability] [File filters & formats] [Scripting, plugins & automation] It would be great to have an export/import review files feature as a default function of OmegaT - based on ODT Review plugin but covering also other file formats. A possibility to import reviewed translation is of tremendous help.

#1701 (2023-05-19) Notifications pane [UI, windows & usability] [Machine translation] [Search & replace] When MT connectors or other search features catch errors, an error message will be shown in status bar but manytime it is just a short time and no way to read all the message. #1224 (2016-04-06) Aligner: Ignore red cells during realign-pending [Alignment] [UI, windows & usability] When a user changes a bead from pending uncoloured to needs-review red , he probably has a reason for doing so. :- However, if he uses the realign-pending function, his work is lost, as all red rows between green rows are reset to pending. Suggestion: When using realign-pending, the red rows should remain untouched they should not be re-aligned and they should remain red . I can think of two ways

#1223 (2016-04-06) Aligner: move split-off portion to next bead [Alignment] [Editor & segmentation] Currently, when splitting a cell that is the last cell in a bead, the split-off portion remains in that bead. I think the most probable expectation when a user splits a cell is to remove that split-off portion from the current segment and put it in the next segment i.e. align the split-off portion of text with the other column's next row . Therefore, I suggest that when a user splits a segment, th

#1217 (2016-04-04) Aligner: protect/grey/hide orphaned cells (i.e., delete cells) [Alignment] During an alignment there may be cells of which it is clear to the user that they have no equivalent in the other column. In other words, they are orphaned pieces of text. However, they remain visble, and they are treated as normal text during moves and merge/split operations, which is a bother because the user has to always work around them and mentally ignore them. In other aligners, one would s

#1216 (2016-04-04) Aligner: a way to mark text in one column temporarily [Alignment] [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] When searching for a cell in the other column that might match the currently selected cell, it can be difficult to keep track of where you are. As soon as you click anywhere, the previously selected cell becomes deselected, and you "lose your place", so to speak. Or, when trying to decide where a chunk of text should begin or end, one is requried to visually remember which cells in the one column

#1215 (2016-04-04) Aligner: simple Find dialog [Alignment] [Translation memory & matches] [Search & replace] [File filters & formats] [UI, windows & usability] During alignment, one would normally look up or down with one's own eyes for a matching cell in the other column, but sometimes such a match is hard to find visually, and sometimes you know exactly what word you're looking for. It would be nice if one could press a shortcut to get a simple Find dialog, which would jump to the next cell in the other column that contains the search term. In other wo

#1214 (2016-04-04) Aligner: protect greened (and possibly also redded) rows [Alignment] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] In the aligner, one can mark a row as "accepted" green or as "needs review" red . However, I have found that rows marked like this are not protected against the up/down arrows or against the merge/split buttons. Furthermore, if a green segment is merged with another, the green is not removed. I suggest that green rows be protected against merging/splitting/moving of cells and I think red rows shou

#1213 (2016-04-01) Aligner: Undo, please [Alignment] [Editor & segmentation] Currently, there is no way of undoing an alignment action in step 2 . If you tried to do something e.g. merge and the result is not what you expected, it is not always simple to undo the effects of the action. I suggest that there be an Undo function built into the aligner, to undo the previous action.

#1212 (2016-03-31) Aligner: different highlight colours for different patterns [Alignment] [UI, windows & usability] This RFE should be read along with 1211 Currently, only one highlight colour is available in the aligner. However, it may be useful to be able to choose more than one colour for different things, e.g. yellow for numbers and pink for punctuation marks. So it would be useful to be able to specify more than one highlight pattern, and specify which colour it should be applied in. I suggest that if a h

#1211 (2016-03-31) Aligner: different highlight patterns for different languages [Alignment] Currently, only one highlight pattern is allowed in the aligner, and it is applied to both source and target text. However, some things that may be useful to highlight differ between languages, e.g. stopwords. For example, "who, what, why, when, how" in Afrikaans is "wie, wat, waarom/hoekom, wanneer, hoe". So it would be useful to be able to specify more than one highlight pattern, and specify whi

#1210 (2016-03-31) Aligner: also ask "are you sure" when exiting at step 1 [Alignment] [Translation memory & matches] [File filters & formats] [Editor & segmentation] [Project handling & files] Currently, if the user tries to exit the aligner at step 1, OmegaT does not query the user's decision but exits directly if no segmentation/filter changes were made or after asking the user if he wants to save changed segmentation/filter settings. When the user tried to exit the aligner at step 2 without having saved the latest TMX, the aligner asks the user if he really wants to exit, and gives a

#946 (2014-01-16) Flag matches inserted in Editor pane resulting from OmegaT-aligned sentence pairs [Alignment] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [UI, windows & usability] I have recently switched from paragraph to sentence segmentation in a project retaining my previous paragraph-segmented TMs. OmegaT's handling of fuzzy matches in such case, however, seems problematic. #1109 (2015-07-08) Add a timestamp to statistics files [Statistics & counting] [Translation memory & matches] [Editor & segmentation] [Documentation & localisation] If a user needs to maintain a record of initial, work-in-progress, and final statistics, then the user has to manually rename project stats match.txt and project stats match per file.txt or both each time before each run, because the current functionality overwrites the file containing the statistics. #911 (2013-11-07) Allow maximize/minimize statistics. [Statistics & counting] [UI, windows & usability] The Statistics window is generally too small or too large. It would be nice if it would be possible to maximize it with just one click. Now I have to drag the window borders, which is quite hard across a slow terminal server connection.

#703 (2011-08-03) Progress indicator in Find dialog for file search [Statistics & counting] [Search & replace] [UI, windows & usability] Currently, if the user searches files and there are many files, the result takes a while to display. Since some translators use these statistics for billing and this issue is not immediately apparent, OmegaT should update the statistics. If this is too much programming eff

This doesn't just concern the edit field, but the entire application. Arabic menu's should start at the right, not the left, for example.
